items.title: 〈能源盤後〉沙國遭攻擊、荷姆茲海峽油輪遇襲 國際油價收漲近2%
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: Saudi Attacks, Houthi Strait of Hormuz Tanker Incident Push International Oil Prices Up Nearly 2%
paras: 中東衝突升溫, 沙烏地阿拉伯接連遭到攻擊, 加上荷姆茲海峽油輪遇襲事件持續, 全球原油供應風險再度升高, 抵銷美國總統川普宣布俄羅斯增加柴油出口所帶來的供應利多。
國際油價周一 (12日) 上漲近2%, 布蘭特原油 (Brent) 期貨收盤站上每桶106美元, 創近期新高, 美國西德州中級原油 (WTI) 也升至每桶93美元以上。市場擔憂, 即使俄羅斯增加成品油出口, 中東能源設施及運輸航道若持續遭到攻擊, 全球供應仍可能面臨進一步衝擊。
布蘭特原油期貨周一收漲1.93美元, 漲幅1.8%, 報每桶106.65美元, 創9月15日以來最高收盤價。WTI期貨上漲1.89美元, 漲幅2%, 收在每桶93.74美元。盤中布蘭特原油一度上漲2.04美元, 漲幅2%, 至每桶106.76美元; WTI則升至每桶93.69美元, 同樣上漲約2%。
這波漲勢主要受到沙烏地阿拉伯安全局勢惡化影響。與伊朗立場一致的葉門胡塞武裝組織宣稱, 周六對沙國首都利雅德國際機場發動攻擊, 造成13人死亡、逾300人受傷, 周日又傳出進一步攻擊事件。市場擔憂, 相關衝突可能擴大, 進一步威脅沙烏地阿拉伯這個全球主要產油國的能源生產與出口。
投資人及分析師納維利耶指出, 胡塞武裝對利雅德機場發動致命飛彈攻擊, 預料將使沙烏地阿拉伯對胡塞武裝的報復行動升級。他並表示, 沙國煉油廠目前仍在運作, 但此前在一條通往紅海的管線關閉後, 曾有5座煉油廠暫時停工, 顯示能源基礎設施與運輸管線仍是市場關注的風險。
荷姆茲海峽的航運安全同樣受到關注。本月已有多起油輪遇襲事件傳出, 可能打斷9月以來中東原油出口逐步恢復的趨勢。英國海事貿易行動辦公室通報, 一艘油輪在阿曼索哈爾附近遭無人機攻擊, 另一艘油輪則在通過荷姆茲海峽時受損。由於該海峽是全球重要能源運輸通道, 若航運風險持續升高, 船舶可能延後航行、改變路線或提高保險及運輸成本, 進一步推升原油價格。
SEB大宗商品分析師希爾德羅普表示, 荷姆茲海峽原油出口原本逐步恢復正常的預期, 上周已遭到破壞, 胡塞武裝最新對沙烏地阿拉伯的攻擊又加劇市場憂慮。他指出, 隨著威脅增加, 各國可能面臨艱難的防衛取捨, 必須在石油設施、軍事基地、王宮及民用機場等目標之間配置防衛資源。
高盛 (Goldman Sachs) (GS-US) 將布蘭特原油12月價格預測從每桶85美元上調至90美元, 並估計目前油價包含略高於每桶20美元的地緣政治風險溢價。高盛分析師也預期, 由於美國與歐洲之間的運輸成本偏高, WTI相較布蘭特原油的價格折價異常擴大, 預估WTI在2026年12月平均價格為每桶81美元, 2027年平均價格為每桶73美元。
另一方面, 川普日前宣布, 俄羅斯將立即向美國及全球市場供應逾30萬公噸柴油, 相當於約225萬桶, 後續還將增加供應。消息公布後, 倫敦洲際交易所 (ICE) 柴油期貨下跌2.3%, 報每公噸1,449美元, 顯示市場預期俄羅斯增供有助緩解成品油供應壓力。然而, 分析師認為, 這項協議對全球能源市場的實際影響仍存在不確定性。
俄羅斯已部分解除柴油出口禁令, 估計可釋出約50萬公噸柴油, 相當於約370萬桶。PVM能源分析師瓦爾加指出, 這批供應約相當於美國一天的柴油消費量, 以及全球柴油需求的13%, 但俄羅斯煉油能力近期受到嚴重削弱, 使實際供貨能力及後續出口規模仍有疑問。
Ritterbusch and Associates分析師里特布施也表示, 俄羅斯柴油供應將在今年剩餘時間逐步增加, 但預期未來一個月的供應量不足以對柴油價格造成明顯下行壓力。他不預期這項協議能在美國期中選舉前大幅降低燃料價格。隨著俄羅斯煉油廠受到烏克蘭攻擊影響, 即使莫斯科放寬出口限制, 仍未必能迅速填補全球柴油供應缺口。
俄烏戰事也為能源市場增添不確定性。川普周日意外宣布, 俄羅斯與烏克蘭已同意停止攻擊能源基礎設施, 希望藉此降低能源供應風險。不過, 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周一指控俄羅斯違反能源停火安排, 俄方則尚未對相關指控作出回應。若能源設施持續遭到攻擊, 即使雙方宣布停火, 市場仍難以確定供應能否穩定恢復。
美國墨西哥灣的原油生產則開始從颶風影響中恢復。颶風 Isaias 周六清晨登陸後, 能源企業陸續安排人員返回海上平台並恢復生產, 包括殼牌 (Shell) (SHEL-US)、雪佛龍 (Chevron) (CVX-US) 及英國石油 (BP) (BP-US) 等業者。美國墨西哥灣原油產量的恢復速度, 將影響短期供應狀況, 但中東地緣政治風險仍是目前國際油價的主要推動因素之一。
國際能源總署 (IEA) 署長比羅爾則呼籲, 各會員國應重新評估是否需要進一步釋出柴油儲備, 尚未完全履行先前承諾的國家也應加快釋出速度, 並優先增加柴油供應。這項呼籲凸顯全球成品油市場仍然吃緊, 各國可能需要透過儲備釋出及增加出口, 緩解能源供應壓力。
整體而言, 沙烏地阿拉伯遭到攻擊、荷姆茲海峽油輪遇襲, 以及俄烏能源停火能否落實, 正主導市場對原油供應的判斷。川普宣布俄羅斯增加柴油出口, 雖使柴油期貨下跌, 但尚不足以抵銷中東衝突升級帶來的原油供應風險。隨著市場重新評估地緣政治風險溢價, 原油價格短期內仍可能受到攻擊事件、能源設施恢復進度及主要產油區出口狀況牽動。
paras_en: The Middle‑East conflict is heating up, with Saudi Arabia repeatedly hit and the ongoing Houthi attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz raising global crude‑supply risks, offsetting the supply boost from President Trump’s announcement that Russia will increase diesel exports.

International oil prices rose close to 2% on Monday (the 12th). Brent futures closed above $106 a barrel, a recent high, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) also climbed above $93 a barrel. Markets worry that even if Russia lifts product‑oil exports, continued attacks on Middle‑East energy facilities and transport routes could further strain global supply.

Brent futures rose $1.93 on Monday, up 1.8% to $106.65 a barrel, the highest close since September 15. WTI futures gained $1.89, up 2% to $93.74 a barrel. During the session Brent briefly jumped $2.04, a 2% rise to $106.76, while WTI peaked at $93.69, also about a 2% increase.

The rally is mainly driven by deteriorating security in Saudi Arabia. The Yemen‑based Houthi group, aligned with Iran, claimed a Saturday missile attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport that killed 13 and injured more than 300, with further attacks reported on Sunday. Markets fear the conflict could expand, threatening Saudi Arabia’s oil production and exports.

Investor and analyst Naville said the Houthi missile strike on the airport is likely to trigger a stronger Saudi retaliation. He noted that Saudi refineries are still operating, but after a pipeline to the Red Sea was shut, five refineries were temporarily idled, highlighting ongoing concerns over energy infrastructure and transport pipelines.

Shipping security in the Strait of Hormuz is also under scrutiny. Multiple tanker attacks have been reported this month, potentially disrupting the gradual recovery of Middle‑East crude exports since September. The UK Maritime Trade Operations office said a tanker was hit by a drone near Sohar, Oman, and another was damaged while transiting the strait. Because the strait is a key global energy corridor, rising shipping risks could delay voyages, force reroutes or raise insurance and freight costs, further lifting crude prices.

SEB commodities analyst Hildrop said expectations that Hormuz crude exports would return to normal were shattered last week, and the latest Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia has heightened market anxiety. He added that as threats grow, countries will face tough defence trade‑offs, having to allocate resources among oil facilities, military bases, palaces and civilian airports.

Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) raised its December Brent price forecast from $85 to $90 a barrel and estimates the current price includes a geopolitical risk premium of roughly $20 per barrel. The bank also expects that high trans‑Atlantic freight costs will keep the WTI discount to Brent unusually wide, projecting an average WTI price of $81 a barrel in December 2026 and $73 in 2027.

Meanwhile, Trump recently announced that Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel – about 2.25 million barrels – to the U.S. and global markets, with further increases to follow. After the news, ICE diesel futures fell 2.3% to $1,449 per metric ton, reflecting market expectations that the Russian supply boost will ease product‑oil pressure. Analysts, however, say the agreement’s real impact on the global energy market remains uncertain.

Russia has partially lifted its diesel export ban, potentially releasing about 500,000 metric tons – roughly 3.7 million barrels. PVM Energy analyst Valga noted this amount equals roughly one day of U.S. diesel consumption and about 13% of global diesel demand, but recent severe cuts to Russian refining capacity raise doubts about actual delivery volumes and future export scale.

Ritterbusch and Associates analyst Ritterbusch said Russian diesel shipments will increase gradually over the rest of the year, but he does not expect the volume in the next month to be enough to push diesel prices down noticeably. He doubts the deal will significantly lower fuel prices before the U.S. mid‑term elections. With Russian refineries still hit by Ukrainian attacks, even relaxed export limits may not quickly fill the global diesel gap.

The Russia‑Ukraine war also adds uncertainty to energy markets. Trump unexpectedly announced on Sunday that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to halt attacks on energy infrastructure, hoping to lower supply risk. However, Ukrainian President Zelensky accused Russia on Monday of violating the energy cease‑fire, and Moscow has not responded. If energy sites keep being hit, markets will remain unsure whether supply can stabilise even after a cease‑fire.

Crude production in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico is rebounding from hurricane damage. After Hurricane Isaias made landfall early Saturday, operators such as Shell (SHEL‑US), Chevron (CVX‑US) and BP (BP‑US) have been sending crews back to offshore platforms and restarting output. The pace of Gulf‑of‑Mexico output recovery will affect short‑term supply, but Middle‑East geopolitical risk remains a primary driver of international oil prices.

IEA Executive Director Biewer urged member states to reassess whether further diesel stock releases are needed, and for countries that have not yet fulfilled earlier commitments to accelerate releases and prioritise diesel supply. The call underscores that global product‑oil markets are still tight, and nations may need to draw down reserves and boost exports to ease energy‑supply pressure.

Overall, attacks on Saudi Arabia, tanker incidents in the Strait of Hormuz and the uncertain implementation of a Russia‑Ukraine energy cease‑fire are shaping market views on crude supply. Trump’s announcement of increased Russian diesel exports has pushed diesel futures lower, but it is insufficient to offset the crude‑supply risk from escalating Middle‑East conflict. As markets re‑price geopolitical risk premiums, oil prices in the near term will likely remain sensitive to attack events, the pace of energy‑facility recovery and export conditions in key producing regions.

items.title_en: Pre‑market Taiwan Stock News: Nanya Technology Expects DRAM Prices to Keep Rising in Q4, Delta Electronics Q3 Revenue Hits NT$1970.59 billion, Setting a New Record
paras:
台股盤前要聞 

1.DRAM廠南亞科(2408-TW)12日召開法說，第三季稅後純益876.27億元，季增74.6%、年增55倍，每股純益25.4元；累計前三季稅後純益1637.77億元，每股純益49.28元。展望第四季，南亞科總經理李培瑛表示，AI應用持續擴大，DRAM市場目前仍處於嚴重缺貨狀態，預期第四季平均售價(ASP)持續上漲，毛利率也有機會進一步提升。
2.台達電(2308-TW)12日公告9月營收654億元，創歷史同期新高、單月第三高，月增1.26%、年增14.61%；第三季營收1,970.59億元，創單季新高，季增7.53%、年增31.09%。

3.台塑四寶12日公告9月營收，在地緣政治衝突持續延燒、油價及石化原料價格走揚，加上AI需求帶動電子材料成長下，四家公司9月營收同步繳出年月雙增成績，合計達1,697.69億元，月增8.1%、年增51.9%。其中，台塑化(6505-TW)受惠原油價格回升、煉油廠產能利用率及產銷量大幅提升，9月營收年增65.6%，增幅居四寶之冠；南亞(1303-TW)則受惠電子材料供需吃緊、產品價格上漲，單月營收達344.23億元，創近54個月新高。
4.中鋼(2002-TW)12日公告9月營收310億元，創28個月新高，月增9.2%，年增27.1%；第三季營收886.69億元，季增0.2%、年增20.6%；累計前9月營收2566.71億元，年增6.2%。中鋼表示，鋼價行情築底回穩，在全球鋼市供需改善以及進入第四季傳統備料旺季下，預計整體鋼市逐步向好。
5.水泥雙雄台泥(1101-TW)、亞泥(1102-TW)12日公告9月營收，同步創下2025年1月以來、近21個月新高。台泥營收143.21億元，月增6%、年增7.63%；亞泥營收67.19億元，月增20.2%、年增5.2%。累計前9月，台泥營收1,130.05億元，年增3.3%；亞泥營收504.14億元，年減5.2%。

paras_en: Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) held its earnings briefing on the 12th. Net profit after tax for Q3 was NT$87.627 billion, up 74.6% sequentially and 55‑fold year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$25.4. Cumulative net profit for the first three quarters was NT$163.777 billion, EPS NT$49.28. Looking ahead to Q4, General Manager Li Peiying said AI applications continue to expand and the DRAM market remains in severe shortage; the average selling price (ASP) is expected to keep rising and gross margin may further improve.

Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) announced on the 12th that September revenue was NT$65.4 billion, a historic same‑period high and the third‑largest monthly figure, up 1.26% month‑over‑month and 14.61% year‑over‑year. Q3 revenue reached NT$1,970.59 billion, a new quarterly record, up 7.53% sequentially and 31.09% year‑over‑year.

Formosa Plastics Group’s four major subsidiaries reported September revenue on the 12th. Amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, rising oil and petrochemical raw‑material prices, and AI‑driven growth in electronic materials, the four companies posted double‑digit growth both month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year, totaling NT$169.769 billion, up 8.1% MoM and 51.9% YoY. Among them, Formosa Chemicals (6505‑TW) benefited from higher crude oil prices, increased refinery capacity utilization and sales, posting a 65.6% YoY revenue rise—the highest among the four. Nanya (1303‑TW) saw tight supply‑demand in electronic materials and price hikes, with September revenue of NT$34.423 billion, a 54‑month high.

China Steel (2002‑TW) announced on the 12th September revenue of NT$31.0 billion, a 28‑month high, up 9.2% MoM and 27.1% YoY. Q3 revenue was NT$886.69 billion, up 0.2% sequentially and 20.6% YoY. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$2,566.71 billion, a 6.2% YoY increase. The company said steel prices have bottomed and stabilized; with global steel supply‑demand improving and the traditional fourth‑quarter inventory‑building season approaching, the overall steel market is expected to gradually improve.

Cement leaders Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) and Asia Cement (1102‑TW) reported September revenue on the 12th, both reaching their highest levels since January 2025, a near 21‑month peak. Taiwan Cement posted NT$14.321 billion, up 6% MoM and 7.63% YoY; Asia Cement posted NT$6.719 billion, up 20.2% MoM and 5.2% YoY. For the first nine months, Taiwan Cement’s cumulative revenue was NT$113.005 billion, a 3.3% YoY rise, while Asia Cement’s was NT$50.414 billion, a 5.2% YoY decline.

items.title: 高殖利率該出手了？華爾街看見美債價值 仍提醒別急著抄底
items.title_en: Is It Time to Buy High-Yield Bonds? Wall Street Sees Value in U.S. Treasuries but Warns Against Rushing to Bottom
paras: 美債連周遭到拋售、殖利率攀上多年高點後，華爾街部分策略師開始看見布局機會。高盛認為10年期美債具備反彈條件，花旗則偏好2至3年期美債。不過，各家機構對進場時點仍有分歧，部分策略師提醒，高殖利率雖提高投資吸引力，卻不代表價格已經落底，通膨、聯準會(Fed)政策與美國期中選舉仍是重要變數。
據《彭博》報導，美國債券現貨市場周一(12日)因假日休市，10年期美債殖利率約為5.24%，在上周標售需求強勁後，自數十年高點回落；2年期美債殖利率則相對穩定，約在4.8%附近。市場接下來將聚焦本周美國消費者物價指數(CPI)，評估通膨降溫能否減輕進一步升息的壓力。

美債跌出投資價值 長短天期布局各有偏好

高盛(GS-US)策略師William Marshall團隊指出，多數主要市場的長天期遠期利率已高於合理水準，信用市場開始出現壓力，加上投資人部位與技術性風險改善，都強化目前增加債券利率曝險的理由。
高盛認為，房貸相關部位因利率變動而引發的避險調整壓力已減弱，資產管理業者的債券配置也低於基準，有助改善後續買盤條件。該行偏好10年期部位相對於5年及30年期的表現。
這類布局涉及「存續期間」(duration)，也就是債券價格對利率變動的敏感度。存續期間愈長，通常愈能受惠於殖利率下降，但若殖利率繼續攀升，價格承受的壓力也愈大。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)同樣認為美債已有吸引力。策略師Matthew Hornbach團隊指出，旗下經濟學家預估美國明年名目GDP成長4.5%，暗示10年期美債殖利率應低於5.25%。
若未來十年名目GDP年複合成長率介於4%至5%，核心個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)年增率維持2%，參照量化寬鬆(QE)實施前的歷史關係，10年期美債殖利率應落在3.5%至4.5%。不過，摩根士丹利仍建議等Fed會議及期中選舉結束後再進場。
花旗(C-US)則認為，現階段2至3年期美債是較合適的暫避選擇。策略師Jason Williams團隊指出，通膨與薪資成長放緩，意味Fed不太可能將利率升至2023年的高點，因此對短天期債券較有信心。
三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG-US)也從近期強勁的美債標售需求看到正面訊號，認為殖利率上升幅度已足以吸引價值型投資人，並形容美債處於「深度價值區間」。

高殖利率不代表落底 通膨與升息風險仍待釐清

儘管估值改善，華爾街對Fed下一步行動仍有不同判斷。花旗預估本周公布的核心CPI月增率為0.18%，即使升至0.3%，也不足以支持10月升息，因此預期Fed本月將按兵不動。
美國銀行(BAC-US)策略師Mark Cabana團隊則認為，利率交換市場僅反映約19%的10月升息機率，可能低估政策風險。該行指出，若經濟數據持續強勁，Fed可能必須在升息與放任美債殖利率進一步急升之間作出選擇；一旦債市波動令官員警戒，仍可能促使Fed採取行動。
蒙特婁銀行(BMO-US)也認為，考量Fed主席華許對抑制通膨的重視，目前市場反映的升息機率偏低，儘管該行本身仍預期10月不會升息。其策略師並指出，AI資本支出熱潮等結構性因素，可能使中性利率高於近年水準。
巴克萊(BCS-US)、瑞銀(UBS-US)與富國銀行(WFC-US)則從不同角度提醒，殖利率看似便宜，並不等於上行風險已消失。
巴克萊認為，殖利率上升已收緊金融條件，應能降低Fed急於升息的必要性，但市場同時也在重新評估長期利率的不確定性。該行估算，10年期美債目前提供約1.3至1.5個百分點的期限溢酬，也就是投資人承擔長期持債風險所要求的額外報酬。然而，這項補償既無法防止殖利率續升，也不構成立即買進長債的充分理由。
瑞銀考量經濟活動強勁，以及地緣政治可能推升能源價格，維持戰術性中立。富國銀行則指出，近期標售需求與利率波動均有改善，但長債殖利率若要持續下降，仍需要經濟成長轉弱的催化因素。
富國銀行也提醒，若CPI高於預期，利率向上反應的幅度，可能大於數據符合預期時的下行幅度。該行與多家機構預估，核心CPI月增率將為0.2%。

長債供給可能調整 期中選舉牽動財政前景

除了通膨與政策利率，長天期債券供給能否減少，也是市場關注焦點。花旗預期，美國財政部長貝森特可能在11月4日季度再融資公告中，將20年及30年期公債每次標售規模各削減30億美元，並增加短期國庫券發行，以支應資金需求。
美銀引述客戶回饋指出，市場認為上述長債標售規模下調的機率約為35%至40%，預估各減少20億至30億美元。不過，蒙特婁銀行並不預期下月附息公債標售規模會調整，顯示供給縮減尚未形成共識。
本周五的一級交易商調查，可能提供財政部政策方向的線索。花旗認為，調查也可能觸及大型雲端業者增加投資級公司債發行，是否排擠長天期美債需求的問題。
多倫多道明銀行(TD-US)旗下道明證券預期，大型雲端業者發債速度將放緩，因為舉債成本已明顯高於股權資金成本。該行指出，這些企業即使對利率較不敏感，也不代表完全不在意融資成本，發債降溫有助緩解美債投資人對資金遭排擠的疑慮。
不過，瑞銀認為，即使財政部調整發債策略，有助長債相對於利率交換的表現，只要結構性與基本面因素持續推升期限溢酬，就難以明顯壓低長天期殖利率。
11月期中選舉則可能進一步改變財政與監管前景。三菱日聯認為，民主黨勝選可能形成財政僵局、限制額外支出，並在2027年加強AI監管，對美債形成支撐；共和黨勝選則可能帶來更多財政擴張，對債券不利。
三菱日聯的政策預測也較市場偏鴿，基本情境是未來12個月利率淨變動為零，至多先於12月升息一次，再於明年9月降息一次。隨著通膨、發債計畫及選舉結果陸續揭曉，美債目前的估值吸引力能否轉化為持續反彈，將更為明朗。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury bonds have been sold off in recent weeks, pushing yields to multi‑year highs, and some Wall Street strategists are now spotting positioning opportunities. Goldman Sachs believes the 10‑year Treasury has rebound potential, while Citi prefers the 2‑ to 3‑year segment. However, firms differ on timing; several strategists caution that higher yields increase attractiveness but do not mean prices have bottomed, with inflation, Fed policy and the U.S. midterm elections remaining key variables.

According to Bloomberg, the U.S. bond cash market was closed for a holiday on Monday (the 12th). The 10‑year Treasury yield was about 5.24%, having slipped from a decades‑high after strong auction demand last week; the 2‑year yield stayed relatively steady near 4.8%. Market focus now shifts to this week’s U.S. consumer price index (CPI) to gauge whether cooling inflation could ease pressure for further rate hikes.

U.S. Treasuries have fallen out of valuation; preferences differ across the curve. Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) strategist William Marshall’s team notes that forward rates on most major markets’ long end are above reasonable levels, credit markets are feeling pressure, and improved investor positioning and technical risk bolster the case for adding bond‑duration exposure.

Goldman sees reduced hedging pressure from mortgage‑related positions as rates shift, and asset managers’ bond allocations remain below benchmarks, improving buying conditions. The firm favors the 10‑year segment relative to the 5‑year and 30‑year issues.

This type of positioning involves "duration," the sensitivity of bond prices to rate changes. Longer duration generally benefits more from falling yields, but if yields keep rising, price pressure intensifies.

Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) also finds Treasuries attractive. Strategist Matthew Hornbach’s team cites internal economists projecting a 4.5% nominal GDP growth for next year, implying the 10‑year yield should stay below 5.25%.

If nominal GDP compounds at 4‑5% over the next decade and core personal consumption expenditures (PCE) inflation stays at 2%, historical pre‑QE relationships suggest a 10‑year yield of 3.5‑4.5%. Morgan Stanley, however, advises waiting until after the Fed meeting and the midterm elections to enter.

Citi (C‑US) believes the current 2‑ to 3‑year Treasuries are a more suitable short‑term shelter. Strategist Jason Williams’ team points to slowing inflation and wage growth, meaning the Fed is unlikely to push rates back to 2023 highs, bolstering confidence in short‑duration bonds.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG‑US) also sees a positive signal from recent strong Treasury auction demand, saying the yield rise has been enough to attract value‑oriented investors and describing Treasuries as being in a "deep value zone."

High yields do not equal a bottom; inflation and rate‑rise risks remain unresolved. Despite valuation improvements, Wall Street still disagrees on the Fed’s next move. Citi forecasts this week’s core CPI month‑over‑month increase at 0.18%; even a rise to 0.3% would be insufficient to justify a October hike, so the bank expects the Fed to hold steady this month.

Bank of America (BAC‑US) strategist Mark Cabana’s team argues that the interest‑rate swap market reflects only about a 19% chance of a October hike, potentially underestimating policy risk. They note that if economic data stay strong, the Fed may have to choose between further hikes and allowing Treasury yields to surge; heightened bond‑market volatility could still prompt Fed action.

BMO (BMO‑US) also sees the Fed Chair’s focus on curbing inflation as keeping market‑implied hike probabilities low, even though the bank itself does not expect an October hike. Its strategists add that structural factors such as the AI‑driven capex boom could push the neutral rate above recent levels.
Barclays (BCS‑US), UBS (UBS‑US) and Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) each warn from different angles that seemingly cheap yields do not mean upside risk has vanished.

Barclays argues that rising yields have tightened financial conditions, reducing the Fed’s urgency to hike, yet markets are re‑evaluating long‑term rate uncertainty. The bank estimates the 10‑year Treasury currently offers a term premium of about 1.3‑1.5 percentage points, the extra return investors demand for bearing long‑duration risk. However, this premium cannot prevent further yield rises nor justify an immediate long‑bond purchase.

UBS maintains a tactically neutral stance, citing strong economic activity and geopolitical risks that could lift energy prices. Wells Fargo notes that recent auction demand and rate volatility have improved, but a continued decline in long‑bond yields would still require a catalyst of weaker growth.

Wells Fargo also cautions that if CPI comes in above expectations, the upward rate reaction could be larger than the downward move when data meet forecasts. The bank, along with several peers, projects core CPI month‑over‑month at 0.2%.

Supply of long‑dated bonds could also shift, influencing the market. Citi expects Treasury Secretary Yellen to announce on November 4 a quarterly refinancing plan that trims each 20‑year and 30‑year auction by $30 billion and boosts short‑term Treasury issuance to meet cash needs.

Bank of America, citing client feedback, estimates the probability of such long‑bond auction cuts at roughly 35‑40%, with expected reductions of $20‑30 billion each. However, BMO does not anticipate any adjustment to the coupon‑bearing bond auction size next month, indicating no consensus on supply cuts yet.

A dealer survey released Friday may give clues about Treasury policy direction. Citi believes the poll could also touch on whether large cloud providers increasing investment‑grade corporate‑bond issuance might crowd out demand for long‑dated Treasuries.

TD Bank’s (TD‑US) TD Securities expects cloud giants to slow their bond issuance as borrowing costs now clearly exceed equity financing costs. The bank notes that even if these firms are less rate‑sensitive, they still care about financing costs, and a slowdown in issuance helps ease investors’ concerns about capital being displaced from Treasuries.

Nevertheless, UBS thinks that even if the Treasury adjusts its issuance strategy, the relative performance of long bonds versus rate swaps will improve, and as long as structural and fundamental factors keep pushing term premiums higher, long‑term yields will be hard to push down significantly.

The November midterms could further reshape fiscal and regulatory outlooks. MUFG sees a Democratic win potentially leading to a fiscal stalemate, limiting extra spending and tightening AI regulation by 2027, which would support Treasuries; a Republican victory could spur more fiscal expansion, weighing on bonds.

MUFG’s policy outlook is also more dovish than the market, assuming net zero interest‑rate change over the next 12 months, at most one hike before December and a cut in September 2025. As inflation, issuance plans and election results unfold, it will become clearer whether the current valuation appeal of Treasuries can translate into a sustained rebound.

items.title: 砸重金挖人才終於交卷！Meta推最強AI模型 叫陣ChatGPT與Claude
items.title_en: Meta Drops Huge Money to Recruit Talent and Finally Delivers! Announces Its Strongest AI Model to Take on ChatGPT and Claude
paras: Meta(META-US)周一(12日)推出Muse Wonder與Muse Wonder Full，宣稱是旗下至今能力最強的AI模型，盼在執行長祖克柏投入鉅資重整AI團隊後，加速追趕OpenAI與Anthropic。消息帶動Meta股價盤中一度上漲4.7%，午後漲幅約4%；截至上周五收盤，今年累計上漲近9%。
綜合外媒報導，內部代號「西瓜」的Muse Wonder，是Meta重整AI組織後的重要成果。公司表示，新模型在程式設計、金融與法律問題處理上，具備可與ChatGPT及Claude競爭的能力。不過，基準測試未必反映實際使用表現，相關宣稱仍待外部驗證。

重整團隊拚技術突破 個人AI代理成競爭重心

過去一年半，祖克柏積極延攬研究人才，承諾投入數千億美元建置AI基礎設施，並透過對Scale AI投資140億美元，延攬Alexandr Wang領軍新的AI部門。Meta表示，團隊在14個月內，已從重建基礎走到推進技術前沿。
Wang表示，Muse Wonder在個人與專業AI代理任務上具備頂尖能力。相較其他業者著重程式設計代理，Meta更聚焦廣泛的消費者用途，希望讓AI協助使用者處理日常事務。
Meta上月推出個人AI代理Muse，新模型將很快用於其訂閱版本；能力更強的Muse Wonder Full，則已向AI程式設計工具Muse Code的訂閱用戶開放。開發者目前也可透過Meta Model API及Muse Code使用Muse Wonder。
Muse的訂閱服務可望為Meta龐大的AI投資開闢新收入來源，但用戶隱私疑慮仍是公司必須面對的問題。

強化長期記憶與任務執行 大規模部署仍須降低成本

為提升個人代理的實用性，Meta加入「主動記憶」與「主動專注」能力。Wang表示，模型可保留跨越數天、數周甚至數月的相關使用者資訊，減少用戶反覆交代背景的需求。
遇到困難或執行受阻時，代理也能嘗試不同策略、持續處理任務，進一步應對更複雜、甚至指示不完全明確的要求，而不只執行簡單指令。
Wang領導的Meta超級智慧實驗室已開始研發規模更大的模型，同時設法降低服務數十億用戶的成本。他坦言，Muse Wonder比規模較小的Muse Spark模型更大、運作成本也更高，因此團隊正開發專用版本，希望保留主要能力，又能提高大規模部署效率。
Meta去年推出的模型未能在矽谷獲得預期迴響。若Muse Wonder能通過外部測試，並獲研究人員與開發者採用，將成為AI重整見效的重要證據。對仍持懷疑態度的人，Wang表示，應親自試用模型再作判斷。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) on Monday (the 12th) launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, claiming they are the company’s most powerful AI models to date, hoping that after CEO Mark Zuckerberg poured massive funds into revamping the AI team, they can accelerate the race against OpenAI and Anthropic. The news lifted Meta’s share price, which rose as much as 4.7% during trading and about 4% in the afternoon; by Friday’s close it had climbed nearly 9% year‑to‑date.

According to foreign media reports, the internally codenamed “Watermelon” Muse Wonder is a key outcome of Meta’s AI reorganization. The company says the new model can compete with ChatGPT and Claude on programming, finance and legal problem‑solving. However, benchmark tests may not reflect real‑world performance, and the claims still need independent verification.

Reorganizing the team to chase technical breakthroughs, personal AI agents become the competitive focus. Over the past 18 months, Zuckerberg has actively recruited research talent, pledged billions of dollars to build AI infrastructure, and invested $14 billion in Scale AI to bring in Alexandr Wang to lead a new AI division. Meta says the team has moved from rebuilding the foundation to pushing the technical frontier within 14 months.

Wang said Muse Wonder has top‑tier capabilities for personal and professional AI‑agent tasks. Unlike other players that focus on programming agents, Meta is concentrating on broader consumer uses, aiming to let AI help users handle everyday matters.

Meta rolled out the personal AI agent Muse last month, and the new model will soon be used in its subscription version; the more powerful Muse Wonder Full is already available to subscribers of the AI programming tool Muse Code. Developers can also access Muse Wonder via the Meta Model API and Muse Code.
Muse’s subscription service could open a new revenue stream to offset Meta’s massive AI investment, but user‑privacy concerns remain an issue the company must address.

Strengthening long‑term memory and task execution, large‑scale deployment still needs cost reduction. To make personal agents more practical, Meta added “active memory” and “active focus” capabilities. Wang said the model can retain relevant user information across days, weeks or even months, reducing the need for users to repeatedly re‑state context.

When encountering difficulties or blocked execution, the agent can try different strategies and keep working on the task, handling more complex or partially ambiguous instructions rather than just simple commands.

Wang’s Meta Superintelligence Lab has begun developing even larger models while trying to cut the cost of serving billions of users. He admitted Muse Wonder is larger and more expensive to run than the smaller Muse Spark model, so the team is building a specialized version that retains core abilities but improves large‑scale deployment efficiency.

Meta’s models launched last year failed to generate the expected buzz in Silicon Valley. If Muse Wonder passes external testing and gains adoption by researchers and developers, it will serve as key evidence that the AI overhaul is bearing fruit. For skeptics, Wang said they should try the model themselves before forming a judgment.

items.title: 利率小步快調 別等以後大幅升息！Fed哈瑪克釋鷹派訊號
items.title_en: Small, Quick Rate Adjustments: Don’t Wait for Bigger Hikes Later! Fed’s Hammack Sends Hawkish Signal
paras: 克里夫蘭聯邦準備銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)周一(12日)表示，通膨壓力已擴及多個領域，聯準會(Fed)應維持具限制性的貨幣政策，必要時採取較快速、小幅度的調整，避免高通膨心態在經濟中根深蒂固。她的談話也顯示，為使通膨及時回到2%目標，Fed可能仍須進一步升息。
綜合外媒報導，哈瑪克在全美企業經濟協會(NABE)年會預備講稿中表示，考量影響政策判斷的各項因素，採取限制性貨幣政策是適當的。她說：「在可行的情況下，我通常認為，較小幅度、相對迅速地調整政策，優於持續等待，最終冒著必須大幅修正方向的風險。」
哈瑪克今年擁有聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)投票權，也是Fed內部較偏鷹派的官員之一。她在7月會議投下異議票，主張升息；到了9月，包括Fed主席華許在內的其他官員，也加入支持升息的行列，推動Fed三年來首次上調利率，將政策利率區間升至3.75%至4.00%。
9月會議紀錄顯示，官員認為仍可能需要再次升息，但未明確指出行動時點。根據芝商所(CME-US)FedWatch工具，交易員預估Fed在10月27日至28日會議按兵不動的機率超過78%，至12月今年最後一次會議時升息的機率則接近88%。
哈瑪克強調，目前通膨並非集中於單一項目。石油、零售汽油及柴油價格今年上漲，雖然成為市場焦點，卻不足以解釋整體物價壓力。她近期與轄區企業交流時發現，部分業者計劃提高售價，且漲幅將超過投入成本的增幅。
AI基礎建設熱潮也帶來需求面壓力。哈瑪克指出，AI建設推高關鍵電腦、電子與高科技零組件價格，不僅增加資料中心成本，也波及使用類似零組件的航空、發電及建築工程。
美國8月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)年增3.4%，排除食品與能源的核心PCE則年增3%。哈瑪克表示，克里夫蘭Fed研究人員估計，目前潛在通膨約落在2%至3%區間的中高段。即使採取適當政策，她的基本預測仍是通膨需要一段時間才能回到2%。
她指出，實際通膨高於目標已超過五年，長期通膨預期卻依然相當穩定，但決策官員不能將此視為理所當然。「每多過一個月，通膨持續偏高，都會增加通膨心態在經濟中根深蒂固的風險。」
至於經濟能否承受進一步緊縮，哈瑪克認為，目前數據並未顯示經濟已疲弱不堪，反而反映仍有能力承受更緊的政策，以完成壓低通膨的工作。
哈瑪克也強調，官員應持續向外界解釋政策觀點，尤其是面對不同經濟數據時，可能如何調整決策。華許先前曾表示，希望Fed「少說話」，並特別反對透過前瞻指引，對未來政策決定作出明確承諾。
哈瑪克則認為，說明政策如何回應數據，有助家庭與企業理解決策官員處理新資訊的方式，進而安排自身計畫。她表示，自己有責任向公眾解釋決策理由，透明度能讓消費者、企業與金融市場作出更充分掌握資訊的決定。
paras_en: Cleveland Federal Reserve Bank President Beth Hammack said on Monday (the 12th) that inflation pressures have spread across multiple sectors and the Fed should maintain a restrictive monetary policy, making faster, smaller adjustments when needed to prevent a high‑inflation mindset from taking root in the economy. Her remarks also suggest that further rate hikes may still be required to bring inflation back to the 2% target in a timely manner.

According to foreign media reports, Hammack said in a preparatory speech for the National Association of Business Economists (NABE) annual meeting that, given the various factors influencing policy judgment, a restrictive monetary stance is appropriate. She added, “When feasible, I generally believe that smaller, relatively swift policy adjustments are preferable to waiting indefinitely and eventually facing the risk of having to make a large‑scale correction.”

Hammack, who holds a voting seat on the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) this year, is one of the more hawkish officials inside the Fed. She cast a dissenting vote at the July meeting in favor of a rate hike; by September, other officials, including Fed Chair Jerome Powell, also joined the push for hikes, leading to the Fed’s first rate increase in three years, moving the policy rate range to 3.75%‑4.00%.

The September meeting minutes showed that officials still thought another hike might be needed, though they did not specify a timing. Based on CME‑US FedWatch, traders estimate a more than 78% chance the Fed will hold steady at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting and about an 88% chance of a hike at the final meeting in December this year.

Hammack emphasized that inflation is not concentrated in a single item. Oil, retail gasoline and diesel prices have risen this year and dominate headlines, but they do not fully explain overall price pressure. In recent conversations with businesses in her district, she found that some firms plan to raise prices, and the increases will exceed the rise in input costs.

The AI infrastructure boom is also adding demand‑side pressure. Hammack noted that AI‑driven construction is pushing up prices for key computers, electronics and high‑tech components, raising data‑center costs and spilling over to sectors such as aviation, power generation and construction that use similar parts.

U.S. personal consumption expenditures (PCE) prices rose 3.4% year‑over‑year in August, with core PCE (excluding food and energy) up 3% annually. Hammack said Cleveland Fed researchers estimate that underlying inflation now sits in the upper‑mid range of 2%‑3%. Even with appropriate policy, her baseline view is that it will take time for inflation to return to 2%.

She pointed out that actual inflation has been above target for more than five years, yet long‑term inflation expectations remain fairly stable; policymakers cannot take that for granted. “Each additional month that inflation stays elevated raises the risk of a high‑inflation mindset becoming entrenched in the economy,” she warned.

Regarding whether the economy can bear further tightening, Hammack believes current data do not show a severely weakened economy; rather, they suggest it still has capacity to absorb tighter policy to achieve lower inflation.

Hammack also stressed that officials should keep explaining their policy views to the public, especially how they might adjust decisions in response to varying economic data. Powell has previously said he wants the Fed to “talk less” and has been particularly opposed to forward guidance that commits the Fed to specific future actions.

She argued that explaining how policy reacts to data helps households and firms understand how decision‑makers process new information, allowing them to plan accordingly. Hammack said she feels responsible for communicating the rationale behind decisions, noting that transparency enables consumers, businesses and financial markets to make better‑informed choices.

items.title: 跌下來反而更值得買？高盛升評全球股市 看好財報助攻
items.title_en: Is a Drop Actually a Better Buying Opportunity? Goldman Sachs Upgrades Global Stock Outlook, Bullish on Earnings Support
paras: 高盛(GS-US)周一(12日)將全球股票未來三個月的配置評等，由「中立」調升至「加碼」，認為企業獲利成長仍能支撐股市，近期回檔也讓估值更具吸引力，為第三季財報季前的布局提供較佳切入點。
據《路透》報導，這次調整使高盛對全球股市的短期展望，與原本看多未來12個月的立場一致。儘管油價、利率與債務壓力持續干擾市場，該行仍看好企業獲利對股價的支撐作用。
近期中東供應疑慮推升油價，加深市場對通膨及利率將長期維持高檔的擔憂；企業與政府債務不斷增加，也引發全球債券拋售潮，使金融市場在過去幾周承受震盪。
高盛指出，利率與能源價格上升仍是股市短期內的主要風險，美國期中選舉的不確定性，也可能使目前偏低的市場波動程度升高。不過，近期股價拉回已改善進場條件，企業獲利成長則持續提供基本面支撐。
區域配置方面，高盛維持對亞洲及美國股市的「加碼」評等，對歐洲股市則維持「減碼」。
在投資策略上，高盛偏好「槓鈴式配置」，一端持有科技股，另一端配置具有類似債券特性的股票。兩類資產都有望受惠於利率壓力緩解，而後者也能在科技股遭拋售，或市場對經濟成長的疑慮加深時，提供一定的避險效果。
除了股票，高盛也將未來12個月的公債配置評等調升至「加碼」，預期債券在投資組合中的角色將逐漸轉變。該行表示：「我們認為，債券應會逐步從投資組合的拖累因素，轉為避險工具。」
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) on Monday (the 12th) raised its three‑month allocation rating for global equities from "neutral" to "overweight," saying corporate profit growth can still support the market and the recent pullback makes valuations more attractive, offering a better entry point ahead of the Q3 earnings season.

According to Reuters, the upgrade aligns Goldman’s short‑term outlook for global stocks with its previously bullish stance for the next 12 months. Despite ongoing disruptions from oil prices, interest rates and debt pressures, the firm remains confident that corporate earnings will underpin share prices.

Recent concerns over Middle‑East supply have pushed oil prices higher, deepening worries that inflation and interest rates will stay elevated for a long time; rising corporate and sovereign debt has also sparked a global bond sell‑off, leaving financial markets volatile over the past few weeks.

Goldman notes that higher rates and energy prices remain the main short‑term risks for equities, and uncertainty surrounding the U.S. midterm elections could lift the currently low market volatility. However, the recent stock pullback has improved entry conditions, and ongoing earnings growth continues to provide fundamental support.
In terms of regional allocation, Goldman maintains an "overweight" rating for Asian and U.S. equities, while keeping a "underweight" stance on European stocks.

For investment strategy, Goldman favors a "barbell" approach: holding technology stocks on one side and allocating to stocks with bond‑like characteristics on the other. Both asset classes could benefit from easing rate pressure, and the latter can offer a hedge when tech stocks are sold off or concerns about economic growth intensify.

Beyond equities, Goldman also upgraded its 12‑month sovereign bond allocation rating to "overweight," expecting bonds to gradually shift from a drag on portfolios to a defensive tool. The firm said, "We believe bonds will increasingly move from being a portfolio burden to a hedge asset."

items.title: 機會還是警訊？美銀行股財報前陷技術性修正 抄底減碼看法分歧
items.title_en: Opportunity or Warning? US Bank Stocks Face Technical Correction Ahead of Earnings, Diverging Views on Buying the Dip
paras: 美國大型銀行股在財報季登場前陷入修正，長期借款成本升至數十年高點，讓市場更加關注銀行高層對消費者還款能力與經濟前景的評估。儘管交易收入及放款成長預期仍佳，殖利率攀升對資金成本與信用品質的影響，已成投資人焦點。
據《彭博》報導，KBW銀行指數自8月中旬以來下跌逾10%，進入技術性修正，同期美債殖利率急升，聯準會(Fed)也啟動三年來首次升息。該指數剛經歷2023年初以來最差季度表現；當時殖利率上升曾助長區域銀行危機。

交易收入可望亮眼 高利率考驗消費者還款能力

分析師預估，華爾街最大幾家銀行單季股票交易收入合計將接近190億美元，放款可望年增，信用品質則大致穩定。
花旗(C-US)、高盛(GS-US)、摩根大通(JPM-US)及富國銀行(WFC-US)將於周二盤前公布財報，美國銀行(BAC-US)與摩根士丹利(MS-US)則於周三接棒。先行公布業績的Jefferies(JEF-US)上月表示，投資銀行與股票交易業務單季表現創紀錄，其他指標則好壞不一。
宏利(MFC-US)旗下John Hancock Investments策略師Matt Miskin指出，銀行須平衡存款成本與放款收益，如今既受債市波動衝擊，也面臨信用卡、車貸及房貸利率上升的壓力。殖利率提高雖有助收入，卻也可能跨過消費者無力還款的臨界點。
另一方面，摩根大通財報前的選擇權交易偏多。上周末交易顯示，押注上漲10%的買權需求，高於防範下跌10%的賣權，買權未平倉量也較多。

分析師看法分歧 財報反彈能否延續仍待觀察

除高利率與能源成本外，AI代理帶來的潛在衝擊，以及11月期中選舉，也增添變數。民調顯示，選民對經濟與美伊戰爭的不滿，使共和黨支持度流失。共和黨通常支持放寬金融監管，摩根大通分析師因此認為，若該黨意外大勝，可能有利美銀、花旗與富國銀行。
富國銀行分析師Mike Mayo則認為，選舉可能拖慢鬆綁監管，卻不致使其偏離方向；銀行建立的信任是留住存款的優勢，財報也可能扭轉AI引發的恐慌交易。
摩根士丹利分析師Manan Gosalia將近期跌勢視為布局2027年的機會，認為AI投資及經濟韌性仍有支撐，利率上升雖提高融資成本，也有助收入增加。
加拿大帝國商業銀行(CM-US)旗下資本市場策略師Christopher Harvey預期，銀行高層對消費者及經濟的態度將較數月前謹慎。銀行股過去常在財報前落後、公布後反彈，但考量總體逆風，他建議趁反彈降低配置，並較偏好通訊服務與公用事業。
paras_en: US large‑cap bank stocks have entered a technical correction before earnings season, with long‑term borrowing costs climbing to their highest level in decades, prompting the market to focus more on senior bank executives' assessments of consumer repayment ability and the economic outlook. Although expectations for trading revenue and loan growth remain strong, the rise in yields and its impact on funding costs and credit quality have become investors' focal points.

According to Bloomberg, the KBW Bank Index has fallen more than 10% since mid‑August, entering a technical correction, while US Treasury yields surged and the Fed initiated its first rate hike in three years. The index just posted its worst quarterly performance since early 2023, a period when rising yields helped fuel the regional‑bank crisis.

Trading revenue is expected to shine, but high rates test consumers' repayment capacity. Analysts estimate that the combined quarterly stock‑trading revenue of the biggest Wall Street banks will approach $19 billion, loan growth is projected to be positive, and credit quality is broadly stable.

Citigroup (C), Goldman Sachs (GS), JPMorgan Chase (JPM) and Wells Fargo (WFC) will release earnings before the market opens on Tuesday, while Bank of America (BAC) and Morgan Stanley (MS) follow on Wednesday. Jefferies (JEF), which reported earlier, said its investment‑banking and equity‑trading businesses posted record‑quarter results, while other metrics were mixed.

Manulife (MFC) strategist Matt Miskin of John Hancock Investments noted that banks must balance deposit costs against loan yields; they now face bond‑market volatility and pressure from rising credit‑card, auto‑loan and mortgage rates. Higher yields boost income but could also push consumers past the point where they can repay.

On the other hand, options activity ahead of JPMorgan’s earnings was net‑long. Last weekend’s trades showed more demand for call options betting on a 10% rise than for puts protecting against a 10% drop, and open interest in calls was higher.

Analysts are split on whether any earnings bounce can be sustained. In addition to high rates and energy costs, potential AI‑driven disruptions and the November midterm elections add uncertainty. Polls show voter dissatisfaction with the economy and the US‑Iran conflict eroding GOP support; the GOP typically favors loosening financial regulation, leading a JPMorgan analyst to argue that a surprise GOP win could benefit US Bank, Citi and Wells Fargo.

Wells Fargo analyst Mike Mayo believes the election may slow deregulation but not change its direction; the trust banks have built remains a deposit‑retention advantage, and earnings could quell panic trading sparked by AI concerns.

Morgan Stanley analyst Manan Gosalia sees the recent decline as a chance to position for 2027, arguing that AI investment and economic resilience still provide support. While higher rates raise financing costs, they also help increase revenue.

CIBC (CM) capital‑markets strategist Christopher Harvey expects senior bank executives to be more cautious about consumers and the economy than a few months ago. Bank stocks often lag before earnings and rebound afterward, but given the overall headwinds, he recommends trimming exposure on the bounce and favoring communications and utilities sectors.

items.title: 記憶體還在大賺、股市已怕盛宴散場！美光失守千美元
items.title_en: Memory Still Raking in Profits, Stock Market Fears the Feast Is Over! Micron Falls Below $1,000
paras: 記憶體企業獲利持續攀高，股價卻反向走弱。美光(MU-US)周一(12日)盤中下跌近5%，跌破1,000美元，創逾三周低點；SanDisk(SNDK-US)跌幅更達7%。中國長鑫存儲(CXMT)宣布新一代DRAM技術取得進展，加上南韓股市補跌、晶片大廠回購支撐減弱，使投資人開始擔心，記憶體產業即使短期業績強勁，仍可能逐步接近獲利高峰。
據外媒引述高盛(GS-US)交易部門資料報導，美光與SanDisk最近七個交易日中，有六天下跌。美光自6月歷史收盤高點回落近兩成，逼近技術性熊市，顯示市場關注焦點正從眼前供不應求，轉向未來新增產能對價格與獲利的影響。
這波賣壓出現在美光公布強勁展望之後。公司不到兩周前才預估，第一會計季度營收將達600億至630億美元，明顯高於市場預期的568億美元。高盛上周也估算，美光一家就將貢獻標普500企業第三季整體獲利增量的19%，但亮眼數字仍未能穩住股價。

韓股補跌加上回購退場 記憶體龍頭承受賣壓

南韓股市上周五因韓文日休市，周一恢復交易後，補反映美國半導體股前兩個交易日的跌勢。南韓綜合股價指數(KOSPI)下跌3.65%，收6,384.2點，僅略高於6,376點附近的200日均線；科技股比重較高的KOSDAQ指數下跌4.8%，KRX半導體指數則下挫5.2%。
三星電子(005930-KR)與SK海力士(000660-KR)(SKHY-US)均下跌約4.5%。高盛首爾交易部門指出，韓股從開盤起便一路走低，地緣政治緊張與美國記憶體股疲弱共同壓抑市場，外資連續第五個交易日淨賣出。
當天外資賣超南韓科技股約13億美元，其中SK海力士與三星電子分別遭賣超7.82億及4.15億美元。散戶雖買超科技股約12億美元，高盛仍指出，淨買進規模呈現縮減趨勢。
企業回購支撐減弱，也讓市場更難消化賣壓。報導指出，三星電子與SK海力士合計55兆韓元、約400億美元的回購計畫，比原定時程提前數周進入尾聲。其中三星回購實際上已於10月6日結束，SK海力士剩餘買盤也相當有限。
三星回購結束後的三個交易日，KOSPI累計下跌約8%，較6月22日歷史收盤高點回落約30%；SK海力士同期自高點跌幅約45%，三星也下跌約30%。
散戶資金動能同樣降溫。報導引述《彭博》資料指出，南韓股市成交額較5月底高峰萎縮70%，融資餘額從6月的38.6兆韓元降至約33兆韓元，投資人存款則由接近140兆韓元降至約100兆韓元。外資今年已自韓股撤出1,310億美元，規模居亞洲主要市場之首。

長鑫推進新型DRAM架構 市場轉向評估供給威脅

除了資金面，中國競爭者的技術進展也加深疑慮。《南華早報》報導，長鑫存儲總裁曹侃上周六在上海一場產業活動表示，公司在新型DRAM記憶單元結構上取得「關鍵進展」，計劃於2026年底前推出採用該技術的伺服器記憶體產品。
這項技術稱為4F²架構，F代表晶片最小線寬。目前主流商用DRAM採6F²記憶單元設計，若在相同線寬下縮小至4F²，單元面積可減少三分之一，理論上相同面積能容納的記憶單元可增加約50%，但實際提升幅度仍須扣除其他電路與設計需求。
長鑫表示，設計核心為自研的垂直環繞閘極(VSG)電晶體，透過垂直結構降低漏電，同時縮小記憶單元面積。對難以取得極紫外光(EUV)微影設備的業者而言，這提供了不完全依賴更先進製程、也能提高儲存密度的技術路徑。
南韓業者也正研發相同方向的技術。SK海力士於2025年揭露4F²技術藍圖，韓媒The Elec則報導，三星目標是在2028年量產採用此架構的10奈米以下DRAM。
若長鑫如期於今年底推出產品，可能在此一記憶單元架構的商用時程上取得優勢。不過，「關鍵進展」並不等於已具備大規模量產能力，產品能否按期推出，以及良率、效能與成本表現，仍待驗證。
高盛歐洲、中東及非洲股票現貨交易主管Rich Privorotsky指出，中國已占全球DRAM營收約10%，並積極擴產，長鑫的新消息進一步加深市場對記憶體獲利觸頂的擔憂，即使短期基本面依然格外強勁。
宏碁(2353-TW)董事長陳俊聖先前也表示，隨著中國產能持續開出，供應短缺問題已經消失，並預期記憶體價格可能在2027年中見頂。報導指出，宏碁、惠普(HPQ-US)與華碩(2357-TW)已在個人電腦中採用長鑫晶片。
市場擔心的因此不只是未來一、兩季，而是2028年的供需情勢：若中國DRAM供應規模如預期達到SK海力士的一半，同時南韓新廠也陸續投產，可能對價格形成壓力。

南亞科亮眼財報難消疑慮 後續展望成多空關鍵

台灣南亞科(2408-TW)最新財報，反映記憶體業短期獲利依然強勁。公司第三季營收達新台幣1,336億元，季增62%、年增612%；毛利率升至85.7%，較前季增加6.2個百分點，營業利益率達80%。
南亞科單季平均售價上漲逾60%，其中超過一半的漲幅，來自2025年長期合約到期後重新議價。管理層預期，2027年合約價仍有望維持雙位數漲幅，毛利率高於80%也仍可達成。
不過，由於通路庫存接近零，2027年初位元出貨量預料不會成長，要等到2027年第四季新廠產出增加，出貨量才可能出現轉折。高盛台北交易部門認為，儘管財報出色，近期卻缺乏足以推動市場進一步調高估值的新題材。
百達的Jon Withaar向《彭博》表示，記憶體股以目前獲利衡量已顯得便宜，逐漸成為價值型股票，但散戶與短線避險基金追逐的是成長，而非單純低估值。
資金流向也顯示風險偏好轉弱。高盛主要經紀業務資料指出，美國資訊科技業在過去五周中有四周是淨買進最多的產業，上周卻轉為淨賣出最多，賣出速度創七周新高，以科技硬體、儲存設備及半導體最明顯。三星接近九倍的單季營業利益成長，也未能阻止股價下跌。
接下來，市場將關注三星10月29日法說會對2028年供需的判斷，以及客戶長約、第四代高頻寬記憶體(HBM4)量產、資本支出與股東回報政策。SK海力士也將於10月最後一周公布財報。
本周艾司摩爾(ASML-US)與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)的財報，以及SEMICON West展會，則將提供更廣泛的半導體需求訊號。對記憶體股而言，能否證明獲利成長具有延續性，而不只是當前處於高峰，將是影響後續估值的重要因素。
paras_en: Memory makers continue to see profits climb, yet their stock prices are weakening. Micron (MU-US) fell nearly 5% on Monday (the 12th), slipping below $1,000 and hitting a three‑week low; SanDisk (SNDK-US) dropped even more, about 7%. China’s ChangXin Memory (CXMT) announced progress on a new DRAM technology, and together with a rebound in South Korean equities and weaker support from chip‑maker buybacks, investors are beginning to worry that even with strong short‑term earnings, the memory sector may be edging toward its profit peak.

According to foreign media citing Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) trading data, Micron and SanDisk fell on six of the last seven trading days. Micron has retreated nearly 20% from its June historical closing high, approaching a technical bear market, indicating that market focus is shifting from current supply shortages to the impact of future capacity additions on prices and profits.

The selling pressure came after Micron posted a strong outlook. Less than two weeks earlier the company forecast first‑quarter revenue of $60‑$63 billion, well above the market’s $56.8 billion estimate. Goldman Sachs last week estimated Micron alone would contribute about 19% of the S&P 500’s third‑quarter earnings growth, yet the impressive numbers failed to steady the share price.

South Korean equities fell further as buybacks wound down, putting pressure on memory leaders. The Korean market, which was closed on Friday for a Korean‑Japanese holiday, resumed trading on Monday and reflected the two‑day drop in U.S. semiconductor stocks. The KOSPI fell 3.65% to 6,384.2 points, just above its 200‑day moving average near 6,376; the tech‑heavy KOSDAQ slipped 4.8% and the KRX semiconductor index dropped 5.2%.

Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR) and SK Hynix (000660‑KR) (SKHY‑US) each fell about 4.5%. Goldman Sachs’ Seoul trading desk noted that Korean stocks have been sliding since the open, with geopolitical tension and weak U.S. memory stocks jointly suppressing the market, and foreign investors net‑selling for the fifth consecutive day.

That day foreign investors sold roughly $1.3 billion of Korean tech stocks, with SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics net‑selling $782 million and $415 million respectively. Retail investors bought about $1.2 billion of tech stocks, but Goldman Sachs said the net‑buying trend is shrinking.

Weaker buy‑back support also makes it harder for the market to absorb the sell‑off. Reports say Samsung and SK Hynix together have a combined buy‑back program of 55 trillion won (about $40 billion) that is being wrapped up weeks ahead of schedule. Samsung’s buy‑back actually ended on Oct 6, and SK Hynix’s remaining purchase orders are now very limited.

In the three trading days after Samsung’s buy‑back ended, the KOSPI fell roughly 8% in total, about a 30% retreat from its June 22 historical high; SK Hynix fell about 45% from its peak over the same period, while Samsung also dropped about 30%.

Retail capital momentum is also cooling. Bloomberg data cited in the report show Korean market turnover has shrunk 70% from the late‑May peak, margin debt fell from 38.6 trillion won in June to about 33 trillion won, and investor deposits dropped from near 140 trillion won to roughly 100 trillion won. Foreign investors have withdrawn $131 billion from Korean equities this year, the largest outflow among major Asian markets.

Beyond financing, Chinese competitors’ technical progress deepens concerns. The South China Morning Post reported that ChangXin Memory president Cao Kan said at a Shanghai industry event last Saturday that the company has made a “key breakthrough” in a new DRAM cell architecture and plans to launch server memory products using the technology by the end of 2026.

The technology, called the 4F² architecture (F denotes the minimum feature size), shrinks the cell area from the current 6F² design to 4F², cutting area by one‑third. In theory, the same die area could hold about 50% more cells, though actual gains will be offset by other circuit and design requirements.

ChangXin says the core design uses its own vertically‑surrounding‑gate (VSG) transistor, which reduces leakage via a vertical structure while also shrinking cell size. For firms that cannot access extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV) lithography, this offers a path to higher density without relying entirely on more advanced process nodes.

South Korean players are also pursuing similar routes. SK Hynix disclosed a 4F² roadmap for 2025, and Korean media The Elec reported that Samsung aims to mass‑produce sub‑10 nm DRAM using the architecture by 2028.

If ChangXin launches its product by the end of this year, it could gain a timing advantage in commercializing the cell architecture. However, a “key breakthrough” does not guarantee large‑scale production capability; the ability to meet schedule, yield, performance and cost targets remains to be proven.

Goldman Sachs Europe, Middle East and Africa equities head Rich Privorotsky noted that China now accounts for roughly 10% of global DRAM revenue and is expanding capacity aggressively. ChangXin’s news adds to market worries that memory profits may be topping out, even though short‑term fundamentals stay very strong.

Acer (2353‑TW) chairman Chen Jun‑sheng has also said that as Chinese capacity continues to come online, the supply‑shortage issue has vanished and memory prices may peak around mid‑2027. The report adds that Acer, HP (HPQ‑US) and ASUS (2357‑TW) already use ChangXin chips in their PCs.

The market’s concern therefore extends beyond the next one or two quarters to the 2028 supply‑demand picture: if Chinese DRAM output reaches about half of SK Hynix’s capacity while new South Korean fabs come online, price pressure could intensify.

Taiwan’s Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) posted a stellar Q3 report, showing that memory earnings remain robust in the short term. The company recorded NT$133.6 billion revenue for the quarter, up 62% sequentially and 612% year‑on‑year, with gross margin rising to 85.7% (up 6.2 percentage points) and operating margin hitting 80%.

Nanya’s average selling price rose more than 60% in the quarter, with over half of the increase coming from renegotiated contracts after long‑term agreements expired in 2025. Management expects contract prices to still grow double‑digit in 2027, keeping gross margins above 80%.

However, with channel inventories near zero, shipments are not expected to grow in early 2027; only a surge in output from new plants in Q4 2027 could turn the volume trend. Goldman Sachs Taipei’s trading desk says that despite the strong results, there is currently no fresh catalyst to push valuations higher.

Jon Withaar of Baillie Gifford told Bloomberg that memory stocks look cheap on a profit basis and are becoming value plays, yet retail investors and short‑term hedge funds chase growth rather than pure undervaluation.

Capital flows also show weakening risk appetite. Goldman Sachs’ brokerage data indicate that U.S. information‑technology stocks were net‑buyers in four of the past five weeks, but turned into net‑sellers last week, posting the highest weekly sell‑off in seven weeks, led by hardware, storage and semiconductor names. Even Samsung’s near‑nine‑fold quarterly operating‑profit jump could not stop its share decline.

Going forward, the market will watch Samsung’s earnings call on Oct 29 for its 2028 supply‑demand outlook, long‑term customer contracts, HBM4 mass production, capex and shareholder‑return plans. SK Hynix will also release its results in the last week of October.

This week’s earnings from ASML (ASML‑US) and TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US), together with the SEMICON West show, will provide broader semiconductor demand signals. For memory stocks, proving that profit growth can be sustained—not just a peak now—will be a key factor shaping future valuations.

paras_en: Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) held its earnings briefing on the 12th. Net profit after tax for Q3 was NT$87.627 billion, up 74.6% sequentially and 55‑fold year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$25.4. Cumulative net profit for the first three quarters was NT$163.777 billion, EPS NT$49.28. Looking ahead to Q4, General Manager Li Peiying said AI applications continue to expand and the DRAM market remains in severe shortage; the average selling price (ASP) is expected to keep rising and gross margin may further improve.

Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) announced on the 12th that September revenue was NT$65.4 billion, a historic same‑period high and the third‑largest monthly figure, up 1.26% month‑over‑month and 14.61% year‑over‑year. Q3 revenue reached NT$1,970.59 billion, a new quarterly record, up 7.53% sequentially and 31.09% year‑over‑year.

Formosa Plastics Group’s four major subsidiaries reported September revenue on the 12th. Amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, rising oil and petrochemical raw‑material prices, and AI‑driven growth in electronic materials, the four companies posted double‑digit growth both month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year, totaling NT$169.769 billion, up 8.1% MoM and 51.9% YoY. Among them, Formosa Chemicals (6505‑TW) benefited from higher crude oil prices, increased refinery capacity utilization and sales, posting a 65.6% YoY revenue rise—the highest among the four. Nanya (1303‑TW) saw tight supply‑demand in electronic materials and price hikes, with September revenue of NT$34.423 billion, a 54‑month high.

Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$2,566.71 billion, a 6.2% YoY increase. The company said steel prices have bottomed and stabilized; with global steel supply‑demand improving and the traditional fourth‑quarter inventory‑building season approaching, the overall steel market is expected to gradually improve.

Cement leaders Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) and Asia Cement (1102‑TW) reported September revenue on the 12th, both reaching their highest levels since January 2025, a near 21‑month peak. Taiwan Cement posted NT$14.321 billion, up 6% MoM and 7.63% YoY; Asia Cement posted NT$6.719 billion, up 20.2% MoM and 5.2% YoY.
