items.title: 高殖利率該出手了？華爾街看見美債價值 仍提醒別急著抄底
items.title_en: Is It Time to Buy High-Yield Bonds? Wall Street Sees Value in U.S. Treasuries but Warns Against Rushing to Bottom
paras: 美債連周遭到拋售、殖利率攀上多年高點後，華爾街部分策略師開始看見布局機會。高盛認為10年期美債具備反彈條件，花旗則偏好2至3年期美債。不過，各家機構對進場時點仍有分歧，部分策略師提醒，高殖利率雖提高投資吸引力，卻不代表價格已經落底，通膨、聯準會(Fed)政策與美國期中選舉仍是重要變數。
據《彭博》報導，美國債券現貨市場周一(12日)因假日休市，10年期美債殖利率約為5.24%，在上周標售需求強勁後，自數十年高點回落；2年期美債殖利率則相對穩定，約在4.8%附近。市場接下來將聚焦本周美國消費者物價指數(CPI)，評估通膨降溫能否減輕進一步升息的壓力。

美債跌出投資價值 長短天期布局各有偏好

高盛(GS-US)策略師William Marshall團隊指出，多數主要市場的長天期遠期利率已高於合理水準，信用市場開始出現壓力，加上投資人部位與技術性風險改善，都強化目前增加債券利率曝險的理由。
高盛認為，房貸相關部位因利率變動而引發的避險調整壓力已減弱，資產管理業者的債券配置也低於基準，有助改善後續買盤條件。該行偏好10年期部位相對於5年及30年期的表現。
這類布局涉及「存續期間」(duration)，也就是債券價格對利率變動的敏感度。存續期間愈長，通常愈能受惠於殖利率下降，但若殖利率繼續攀升，價格承受的壓力也愈大。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)同樣認為美債已有吸引力。策略師Matthew Hornbach團隊指出，旗下經濟學家預估美國明年名目GDP成長4.5%，暗示10年期美債殖利率應低於5.25%。
若未來十年名目GDP年複合成長率介於4%至5%，核心個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)年增率維持2%，參照量化寬鬆(QE)實施前的歷史關係，10年期美債殖利率應落在3.5%至4.5%。不過，摩根士丹利仍建議等Fed會議及期中選舉結束後再進場。
花旗(C-US)則認為，現階段2至3年期美債是較合適的暫避選擇。策略師Jason Williams團隊指出，通膨與薪資成長放緩，意味Fed不太可能將利率升至2023年的高點，因此對短天期債券較有信心。
三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG-US)也從近期強勁的美債標售需求看到正面訊號，認為殖利率上升幅度已足以吸引價值型投資人，並形容美債處於「深度價值區間」。

高殖利率不代表落底 通膨與升息風險仍待釐清

儘管估值改善，華爾街對Fed下一步行動仍有不同判斷。花旗預估本周公布的核心CPI月增率為0.18%，即使升至0.3%，也不足以支持10月升息，因此預期Fed本月將按兵不動。
美國銀行(BAC-US)策略師Mark Cabana團隊則認為，利率交換市場僅反映約19%的10月升息機率，可能低估政策風險。該行指出，若經濟數據持續強勁，Fed可能必須在升息與放任美債殖利率進一步急升之間作出選擇；一旦債市波動令官員警戒，仍可能促使Fed採取行動。
蒙特婁銀行(BMO-US)也認為，考量Fed主席華許對抑制通膨的重視，目前市場反映的升息機率偏低，儘管該行本身仍預期10月不會升息。其策略師並指出，AI資本支出熱潮等結構性因素，可能使中性利率高於近年水準。
巴克萊(BCS-US)、瑞銀(UBS-US)與富國銀行(WFC-US)則從不同角度提醒，殖利率看似便宜，並不等於上行風險已消失。
巴克萊認為，殖利率上升已收緊金融條件，應能降低Fed急於升息的必要性，但市場同時也在重新評估長期利率的不確定性。該行估算，10年期美債目前提供約1.3至1.5個百分點的期限溢酬，也就是投資人承擔長期持債風險所要求的額外報酬。然而，這項補償既無法防止殖利率續升，也不構成立即買進長債的充分理由。
瑞銀考量經濟活動強勁，以及地緣政治可能推升能源價格，維持戰術性中立。富國銀行則指出，近期標售需求與利率波動均有改善，但長債殖利率若要持續下降，仍需要經濟成長轉弱的催化因素。
富國銀行也提醒，若CPI高於預期，利率向上反應的幅度，可能大於數據符合預期時的下行幅度。該行與多家機構預估，核心CPI月增率將為0.2%。

長債供給可能調整 期中選舉牽動財政前景

除了通膨與政策利率，長天期債券供給能否減少，也是市場關注焦點。花旗預期，美國財政部長貝森特可能在11月4日季度再融資公告中，將20年及30年期公債每次標售規模各削減30億美元，並增加短期國庫券發行，以支應資金需求。
美銀引述客戶回饋指出，市場認為上述長債標售規模下調的機率約為35%至40%，預估各減少20億至30億美元。不過，蒙特婁銀行並不預期下月附息公債標售規模會調整，顯示供給縮減尚未形成共識。
本周五的一級交易商調查，可能提供財政部政策方向的線索。花旗認為，調查也可能觸及大型雲端業者增加投資級公司債發行，是否排擠長天期美債需求的問題。
多倫多道明銀行(TD-US)旗下道明證券預期，大型雲端業者發債速度將放緩，因為舉債成本已明顯高於股權資金成本。該行指出，這些企業即使對利率較不敏感，也不代表完全不在意融資成本，發債降溫有助緩解美債投資人對資金遭排擠的疑慮。
不過，瑞銀認為，即使財政部調整發債策略，有助長債相對於利率交換的表現，只要結構性與基本面因素持續推升期限溢酬，就難以明顯壓低長天期殖利率。
11月期中選舉則可能進一步改變財政與監管前景。三菱日聯認為，民主黨勝選可能形成財政僵局、限制額外支出，並在2027年加強AI監管，對美債形成支撐；共和黨勝選則可能帶來更多財政擴張，對債券不利。
三菱日聯的政策預測也較市場偏鴿，基本情境是未來12個月利率淨變動為零，至多先於12月升息一次，再於明年9月降息一次。隨著通膨、發債計畫及選舉結果陸續揭曉，美債目前的估值吸引力能否轉化為持續反彈，將更為明朗。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury bonds have been sold off in recent weeks, pushing yields to multi‑year highs, and some Wall Street strategists are now spotting positioning opportunities. Goldman Sachs believes the 10‑year Treasury has rebound potential, while Citi prefers the 2‑ to 3‑year segment. However, firms differ on timing; several strategists caution that higher yields increase attractiveness but do not mean prices have bottomed, with inflation, Fed policy and the U.S. midterm elections remaining key variables.

According to Bloomberg, the U.S. bond cash market was closed for a holiday on Monday (the 12th). The 10‑year Treasury yield was about 5.24%, having slipped from a decades‑high after strong auction demand last week; the 2‑year yield stayed relatively steady near 4.8%. Market focus now shifts to this week’s U.S. consumer price index (CPI) to gauge whether cooling inflation could ease pressure for further rate hikes.

U.S. Treasuries have fallen out of valuation; preferences differ across the curve. Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) strategist William Marshall’s team notes that forward rates on most major markets’ long end are above reasonable levels, credit markets are feeling pressure, and improved investor positioning and technical risk bolster the case for adding bond‑duration exposure.

Goldman sees reduced hedging pressure from mortgage‑related positions as rates shift, and asset managers’ bond allocations remain below benchmarks, improving buying conditions. The firm favors the 10‑year segment relative to the 5‑year and 30‑year issues.

This type of positioning involves "duration," the sensitivity of bond prices to rate changes. Longer duration generally benefits more from falling yields, but if yields keep rising, price pressure intensifies.

Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) also finds Treasuries attractive. Strategist Matthew Hornbach’s team cites internal economists projecting a 4.5% nominal GDP growth for next year, implying the 10‑year yield should stay below 5.25%.

If nominal GDP compounds at 4‑5% over the next decade and core personal consumption expenditures (PCE) inflation stays at 2%, historical pre‑QE relationships suggest a 10‑year yield of 3.5‑4.5%. Morgan Stanley, however, advises waiting until after the Fed meeting and the midterm elections to enter.

Citi (C‑US) believes the current 2‑ to 3‑year Treasuries are a more suitable short‑term shelter. Strategist Jason Williams’ team points to slowing inflation and wage growth, meaning the Fed is unlikely to push rates back to 2023 highs, bolstering confidence in short‑duration bonds.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG‑US) also sees a positive signal from recent strong Treasury auction demand, saying the yield rise has been enough to attract value‑oriented investors and describing Treasuries as being in a "deep value zone."

High yields do not equal a bottom; inflation and rate‑rise risks remain unresolved. Despite valuation improvements, Wall Street still disagrees on the Fed’s next move. Citi forecasts this week’s core CPI month‑over‑month increase at 0.18%; even a rise to 0.3% would be insufficient to justify a October hike, so the bank expects the Fed to hold steady this month.

Bank of America (BAC‑US) strategist Mark Cabana’s team argues that the interest‑rate swap market reflects only about a 19% chance of a October hike, potentially underestimating policy risk. They note that if economic data stay strong, the Fed may have to choose between further hikes and allowing Treasury yields to surge; heightened bond‑market volatility could still prompt Fed action.

BMO (BMO‑US) also sees the Fed Chair’s focus on curbing inflation as keeping market‑implied hike probabilities low, even though the bank itself does not expect an October hike. Its strategists add that structural factors such as the AI‑driven capex boom could push the neutral rate above recent levels.
Barclays (BCS‑US), UBS (UBS‑US) and Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) each warn from different angles that seemingly cheap yields do not mean upside risk has vanished.

Barclays argues that rising yields have tightened financial conditions, reducing the Fed’s urgency to hike, yet markets are re‑evaluating long‑term rate uncertainty. The bank estimates the 10‑year Treasury currently offers a term premium of about 1.3‑1.5 percentage points, the extra return investors demand for bearing long‑duration risk. However, this premium cannot prevent further yield rises nor justify an immediate long‑bond purchase.

UBS maintains a tactically neutral stance, citing strong economic activity and geopolitical risks that could lift energy prices. Wells Fargo notes that recent auction demand and rate volatility have improved, but a continued decline in long‑bond yields would still require a catalyst of weaker growth.

Wells Fargo also cautions that if CPI comes in above expectations, the upward rate reaction could be larger than the downward move when data meet forecasts. The bank, along with several peers, projects core CPI month‑over‑month at 0.2%.

Supply of long‑dated bonds could also shift, influencing the market. Citi expects Treasury Secretary Yellen to announce on November 4 a quarterly refinancing plan that trims each 20‑year and 30‑year auction by $30 billion and boosts short‑term Treasury issuance to meet cash needs.

Bank of America, citing client feedback, estimates the probability of such long‑bond auction cuts at roughly 35‑40%, with expected reductions of $20‑30 billion each. However, BMO does not anticipate any adjustment to the coupon‑bearing bond auction size next month, indicating no consensus on supply cuts yet.

A dealer survey released Friday may give clues about Treasury policy direction. Citi believes the poll could also touch on whether large cloud providers increasing investment‑grade corporate‑bond issuance might crowd out demand for long‑dated Treasuries.

TD Bank’s (TD‑US) TD Securities expects cloud giants to slow their bond issuance as borrowing costs now clearly exceed equity financing costs. The bank notes that even if these firms are less rate‑sensitive, they still care about financing costs, and a slowdown in issuance helps ease investors’ concerns about capital being displaced from Treasuries.

Nevertheless, UBS thinks that even if the Treasury adjusts its issuance strategy, the relative performance of long bonds versus rate swaps will improve, and as long as structural and fundamental factors keep pushing term premiums higher, long‑term yields will be hard to push down significantly.

The November midterms could further reshape fiscal and regulatory outlooks. MUFG sees a Democratic win potentially leading to a fiscal stalemate, limiting extra spending and tightening AI regulation by 2027, which would support Treasuries; a Republican victory could spur more fiscal expansion, weighing on bonds.

MUFG’s policy outlook is also more dovish than the market, assuming net zero interest‑rate change over the next 12 months, at most one hike before December and a cut in September 2025. As inflation, issuance plans and election results unfold, it will become clearer whether the current valuation appeal of Treasuries can translate into a sustained rebound.

items.title: 砸重金挖人才終於交卷！Meta推最強AI模型 叫陣ChatGPT與Claude
items.title_en: Meta Drops Huge Money to Recruit Talent and Finally Delivers! Announces Its Strongest AI Model to Take on ChatGPT and Claude
paras: Meta(META-US)周一(12日)推出Muse Wonder與Muse Wonder Full，宣稱是旗下至今能力最強的AI模型，盼在執行長祖克柏投入鉅資重整AI團隊後，加速追趕OpenAI與Anthropic。消息帶動Meta股價盤中一度上漲4.7%，午後漲幅約4%；截至上周五收盤，今年累計上漲近9%。
綜合外媒報導，內部代號「西瓜」的Muse Wonder，是Meta重整AI組織後的重要成果。公司表示，新模型在程式設計、金融與法律問題處理上，具備可與ChatGPT及Claude競爭的能力。不過，基準測試未必反映實際使用表現，相關宣稱仍待外部驗證。

重整團隊拚技術突破 個人AI代理成競爭重心

過去一年半，祖克柏積極延攬研究人才，承諾投入數千億美元建置AI基礎設施，並透過對Scale AI投資140億美元，延攬Alexandr Wang領軍新的AI部門。Meta表示，團隊在14個月內，已從重建基礎走到推進技術前沿。
Wang表示，Muse Wonder在個人與專業AI代理任務上具備頂尖能力。相較其他業者著重程式設計代理，Meta更聚焦廣泛的消費者用途，希望讓AI協助使用者處理日常事務。
Meta上月推出個人AI代理Muse，新模型將很快用於其訂閱版本；能力更強的Muse Wonder Full，則已向AI程式設計工具Muse Code的訂閱用戶開放。開發者目前也可透過Meta Model API及Muse Code使用Muse Wonder。
Muse的訂閱服務可望為Meta龐大的AI投資開闢新收入來源，但用戶隱私疑慮仍是公司必須面對的問題。

強化長期記憶與任務執行 大規模部署仍須降低成本

為提升個人代理的實用性，Meta加入「主動記憶」與「主動專注」能力。Wang表示，模型可保留跨越數天、數周甚至數月的相關使用者資訊，減少用戶反覆交代背景的需求。
遇到困難或執行受阻時，代理也能嘗試不同策略、持續處理任務，進一步應對更複雜、甚至指示不完全明確的要求，而不只執行簡單指令。
Wang領導的Meta超級智慧實驗室已開始研發規模更大的模型，同時設法降低服務數十億用戶的成本。他坦言，Muse Wonder比規模較小的Muse Spark模型更大、運作成本也更高，因此團隊正開發專用版本，希望保留主要能力，又能提高大規模部署效率。
Meta去年推出的模型未能在矽谷獲得預期迴響。若Muse Wonder能通過外部測試，並獲研究人員與開發者採用，將成為AI重整見效的重要證據。對仍持懷疑態度的人，Wang表示，應親自試用模型再作判斷。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) on Monday (the 12th) launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, claiming they are the company’s most powerful AI models to date, hoping that after CEO Mark Zuckerberg poured massive funds into revamping the AI team, they can accelerate the race against OpenAI and Anthropic. The news lifted Meta’s share price, which rose as much as 4.7% during trading and about 4% in the afternoon; by Friday’s close it had climbed nearly 9% year‑to‑date.

According to foreign media reports, the internally codenamed “Watermelon” Muse Wonder is a key outcome of Meta’s AI reorganization. The company says the new model can compete with ChatGPT and Claude on programming, finance and legal problem‑solving. However, benchmark tests may not reflect real‑world performance, and the claims still need independent verification.

Reorganizing the team to chase technical breakthroughs, personal AI agents become the competitive focus. Over the past 18 months, Zuckerberg has actively recruited research talent, pledged billions of dollars to build AI infrastructure, and invested $14 billion in Scale AI to bring in Alexandr Wang to lead a new AI division. Meta says the team has moved from rebuilding the foundation to pushing the technical frontier within 14 months.

Wang said Muse Wonder has top‑tier capabilities for personal and professional AI‑agent tasks. Unlike other players that focus on programming agents, Meta is concentrating on broader consumer uses, aiming to let AI help users handle everyday matters.

Meta rolled out the personal AI agent Muse last month, and the new model will soon be used in its subscription version; the more powerful Muse Wonder Full is already available to subscribers of the AI programming tool Muse Code. Developers can also access Muse Wonder via the Meta Model API and Muse Code.
Muse’s subscription service could open a new revenue stream to offset Meta’s massive AI investment, but user‑privacy concerns remain an issue the company must address.

Strengthening long‑term memory and task execution, large‑scale deployment still needs cost reduction. To make personal agents more practical, Meta added “active memory” and “active focus” capabilities. Wang said the model can retain relevant user information across days, weeks or even months, reducing the need for users to repeatedly re‑state context.

When encountering difficulties or blocked execution, the agent can try different strategies and keep working on the task, handling more complex or partially ambiguous instructions rather than just simple commands.

Wang’s Meta Superintelligence Lab has begun developing even larger models while trying to cut the cost of serving billions of users. He admitted Muse Wonder is larger and more expensive to run than the smaller Muse Spark model, so the team is building a specialized version that retains core abilities but improves large‑scale deployment efficiency.

Meta’s models launched last year failed to generate the expected buzz in Silicon Valley. If Muse Wonder passes external testing and gains adoption by researchers and developers, it will serve as key evidence that the AI overhaul is bearing fruit. For skeptics, Wang said they should try the model themselves before forming a judgment.

items.title: 利率小步快調 別等以後大幅升息！Fed哈瑪克釋鷹派訊號
items.title_en: Small, Quick Rate Adjustments: Don’t Wait for Bigger Hikes Later! Fed’s Hammack Sends Hawkish Signal
paras: 克里夫蘭聯邦準備銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)周一(12日)表示，通膨壓力已擴及多個領域，聯準會(Fed)應維持具限制性的貨幣政策，必要時採取較快速、小幅度的調整，避免高通膨心態在經濟中根深蒂固。她的談話也顯示，為使通膨及時回到2%目標，Fed可能仍須進一步升息。
綜合外媒報導，哈瑪克在全美企業經濟協會(NABE)年會預備講稿中表示，考量影響政策判斷的各項因素，採取限制性貨幣政策是適當的。她說：「在可行的情況下，我通常認為，較小幅度、相對迅速地調整政策，優於持續等待，最終冒著必須大幅修正方向的風險。」
哈瑪克今年擁有聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)投票權，也是Fed內部較偏鷹派的官員之一。她在7月會議投下異議票，主張升息；到了9月，包括Fed主席華許在內的其他官員，也加入支持升息的行列，推動Fed三年來首次上調利率，將政策利率區間升至3.75%至4.00%。
9月會議紀錄顯示，官員認為仍可能需要再次升息，但未明確指出行動時點。根據芝商所(CME-US)FedWatch工具，交易員預估Fed在10月27日至28日會議按兵不動的機率超過78%，至12月今年最後一次會議時升息的機率則接近88%。
哈瑪克強調，目前通膨並非集中於單一項目。石油、零售汽油及柴油價格今年上漲，雖然成為市場焦點，卻不足以解釋整體物價壓力。她近期與轄區企業交流時發現，部分業者計劃提高售價，且漲幅將超過投入成本的增幅。
AI基礎建設熱潮也帶來需求面壓力。哈瑪克指出，AI建設推高關鍵電腦、電子與高科技零組件價格，不僅增加資料中心成本，也波及使用類似零組件的航空、發電及建築工程。
美國8月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)年增3.4%，排除食品與能源的核心PCE則年增3%。哈瑪克表示，克里夫蘭Fed研究人員估計，目前潛在通膨約落在2%至3%區間的中高段。即使採取適當政策，她的基本預測仍是通膨需要一段時間才能回到2%。
她指出，實際通膨高於目標已超過五年，長期通膨預期卻依然相當穩定，但決策官員不能將此視為理所當然。「每多過一個月，通膨持續偏高，都會增加通膨心態在經濟中根深蒂固的風險。」
至於經濟能否承受進一步緊縮，哈瑪克認為，目前數據並未顯示經濟已疲弱不堪，反而反映仍有能力承受更緊的政策，以完成壓低通膨的工作。
哈瑪克也強調，官員應持續向外界解釋政策觀點，尤其是面對不同經濟數據時，可能如何調整決策。華許先前曾表示，希望Fed「少說話」，並特別反對透過前瞻指引，對未來政策決定作出明確承諾。
哈瑪克則認為，說明政策如何回應數據，有助家庭與企業理解決策官員處理新資訊的方式，進而安排自身計畫。她表示，自己有責任向公眾解釋決策理由，透明度能讓消費者、企業與金融市場作出更充分掌握資訊的決定。
paras_en: Cleveland Federal Reserve Bank President Beth Hammack said on Monday (the 12th) that inflation pressures have spread across multiple sectors and the Fed should maintain a restrictive monetary policy, making faster, smaller adjustments when needed to prevent a high‑inflation mindset from taking root in the economy. Her remarks also suggest that further rate hikes may still be required to bring inflation back to the 2% target in a timely manner.

According to foreign media reports, Hammack said in a preparatory speech for the National Association of Business Economists (NABE) annual meeting that, given the various factors influencing policy judgment, a restrictive monetary stance is appropriate. She added, “When feasible, I generally believe that smaller, relatively swift policy adjustments are preferable to waiting indefinitely and eventually facing the risk of having to make a large‑scale correction.”

Hammack, who holds a voting seat on the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) this year, is one of the more hawkish officials inside the Fed. She cast a dissenting vote at the July meeting in favor of a rate hike; by September, other officials, including Fed Chair Jerome Powell, also joined the push for hikes, leading to the Fed’s first rate increase in three years, moving the policy rate range to 3.75%‑4.00%.

The September meeting minutes showed that officials still thought another hike might be needed, though they did not specify a timing. Based on CME‑US FedWatch, traders estimate a more than 78% chance the Fed will hold steady at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting and about an 88% chance of a hike at the final meeting in December this year.

Hammack emphasized that inflation is not concentrated in a single item. Oil, retail gasoline and diesel prices have risen this year and dominate headlines, but they do not fully explain overall price pressure. In recent conversations with businesses in her district, she found that some firms plan to raise prices, and the increases will exceed the rise in input costs.

The AI infrastructure boom is also adding demand‑side pressure. Hammack noted that AI‑driven construction is pushing up prices for key computers, electronics and high‑tech components, raising data‑center costs and spilling over to sectors such as aviation, power generation and construction that use similar parts.

U.S. personal consumption expenditures (PCE) prices rose 3.4% year‑over‑year in August, with core PCE (excluding food and energy) up 3% annually. Hammack said Cleveland Fed researchers estimate that underlying inflation now sits in the upper‑mid range of 2%‑3%. Even with appropriate policy, her baseline view is that it will take time for inflation to return to 2%.

She pointed out that actual inflation has been above target for more than five years, yet long‑term inflation expectations remain fairly stable; policymakers cannot take that for granted. “Each additional month that inflation stays elevated raises the risk of a high‑inflation mindset becoming entrenched in the economy,” she warned.

Regarding whether the economy can bear further tightening, Hammack believes current data do not show a severely weakened economy; rather, they suggest it still has capacity to absorb tighter policy to achieve lower inflation.

Hammack also stressed that officials should keep explaining their policy views to the public, especially how they might adjust decisions in response to varying economic data. Powell has previously said he wants the Fed to “talk less” and has been particularly opposed to forward guidance that commits the Fed to specific future actions.

She argued that explaining how policy reacts to data helps households and firms understand how decision‑makers process new information, allowing them to plan accordingly. Hammack said she feels responsible for communicating the rationale behind decisions, noting that transparency enables consumers, businesses and financial markets to make better‑informed choices.

items.title: 拚科技強國也堆出債務山！中國非金融部門負債突破GDP三倍
items.title_en: Pursuing Technological Superpower Yet Piling Up Debt! China's Non‑Financial Sector Debt Exceeds Three Times GDP
paras: 中國持續透過大規模投資推進科技與軍事強國目標，債務負擔卻同步攀升，不僅壓縮國內經濟活力，也透過過剩產能與出口擴張，加深與貿易夥伴的摩擦。經濟學家指出，中國短期內未必爆發金融危機，但若繼續依賴低成本信貸支撐投資與虧損企業，金融體系恐逐漸失去效率，付出更多債務卻換不到相應成長。
據《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周一(12日)報導，國際清算銀行(BIS)資料顯示，涵蓋企業、政府及家庭借款的中國非金融部門信用總額，去年已超過國內生產毛額(GDP)的300%，較2019年底增加60個百分點，占比也遠高於美國。自習近平2012年底掌權以來，這項信用總額已增加逾43兆美元。

債務推升過剩產能 壓力透過出口向海外擴散

報導指出，大量借款流向需求不足的工廠與住宅建設，造成資源浪費，並引發激烈價格戰，侵蝕企業獲利與員工薪資。背負龐大債務的企業為了償債，持續生產超出國內需求的汽車、太陽能板與電子產品，再將商品銷往海外，使中國對全球的年度貿易順差達到約1兆美元。
這也讓中國債務問題逐漸外溢。包括歐洲在內的貿易夥伴，對中國電動車及其他產品大量湧入日益不滿，但北京目前似乎無意根本改變政策方向。
許多經濟學家認為，中國尚未面臨迫在眉睫的金融危機，部分原因是債務主要仰賴國內儲蓄支應，而非可能迅速撤資的外國投資人。不過，隨著經濟成長動能停滯，虧損企業背負的大量債務愈來愈難償還；若停止向這些企業提供新貸款，又可能使國有銀行承受鉅額損失。
榮鼎集團副董事Camille Boullenois表示，改變現有體系意味必須接受大量損失，而中國政府似乎尚未做好準備。她認為，較可能出現的情境是問題緩慢惡化，金融體系逐步衰退，創造成長的效率愈來愈低。
延後處理債務，也讓習近平得以繼續將資源投入新科技、軍事及其他戰略優先項目。中國官員認為，目前是確立中國與美國並列大國地位的機會窗口，因此將AI、太空科技與能源等核心技術投資視為關鍵。

地方融資平台負擔沉重 低利貸款延續企業借款

中國政府強調債務風險可控，近年中央政府借款約占GDP的30%，相較美國聯邦政府債務水準仍低。然而，這項數字並未涵蓋中國債務問題的主要來源，也就是地方層級的負擔。
過去幾年，地方政府為達成經濟成長目標、維持就業，透過地方政府融資平台新增數兆美元負債。許多平台參與地方房地產開發，也因此受到多年房市低迷重創。
國際貨幣基金(IMF)估計，若將地方政府官方借款及融資平台債務一併納入，中國廣義政府債務去年已膨脹至GDP的127%，高於2020年的98%。
企業債務也在具備良好報酬前景的投資機會減少之際持續增加。麥肯錫資料顯示，中國去年企業債務占GDP比率，約為全球平均的兩倍。
低成本信貸是重要推手。榮鼎集團引述中國央行資料指出，截至去年底，超過半數新增企業貸款的利率，等於或低於銀行提供給最優質企業客戶的貸款基準利率，比重遠高於幾年前。中國上市製造業公司去年的借款利率中位數約為2.4%。

擴大消費有助打破循環 政策轉向面臨戰略取捨

要化解債務問題，中國可能必須根本調整成長策略，降低對工廠等固定資產投資及商品出口的依賴。許多經濟學家主張，政府應優先採取能鼓勵家庭增加支出的政策，避免債務持續累積。
世界銀行資料顯示，2024年中國家庭消費占GDP的40%，美國則接近70%，反映兩國經濟結構的明顯差異。
中國今年第二季GDP年增4.3%，為逾三年來最慢增速，其中相當部分成長來自出口，也凸顯國內需求不足的問題。
北京雖表示希望提高家庭消費，但這意味政府必須減少對經濟資源配置的部分控制，也可能使資金從習近平優先扶植、用以縮小對美科技差距的產業流出。
柏林智庫墨卡托中國研究中心經濟與產業研究主管Jacob Gunter表示，中國官員傾向延續現有路線，但體系已逐漸觸及自身極限。他指出，地方政府補貼虧損企業以維持其營運，然而企業持續虧損，也代表沒有利潤可供課稅，進一步削弱地方財政收入基礎。
paras_en: China continues to push its technology and military superpower goals through massive investment, but its debt burden is rising in tandem, squeezing domestic economic vitality and, via excess capacity and export expansion, deepening friction with trade partners. Economists note that a financial crisis may not erupt in the short term, but if China keeps relying on cheap credit to support investment and loss‑making firms, the financial system could gradually lose efficiency, paying more debt without corresponding growth.

According to a Wall Street Journal report on Monday (the 12th), data from the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) show that total credit for China’s non‑financial sector—including corporate, government and household borrowing—exceeded 300% of GDP last year, up 60 percentage points since the end of 2019 and far higher than the United States. Since Xi Jinping took power at the end of 2012, this total credit has grown by more than $43 trillion.

Debt‑driven excess capacity spreads pressure abroad through exports. The report says large volumes of borrowing have flowed into factories and housing projects that lack demand, wasting resources and sparking fierce price wars that erode corporate profits and workers’ wages. Heavily indebted firms, to service their debt, keep producing cars, solar panels and electronics beyond domestic demand and ship them overseas, helping China generate an annual global trade surplus of about $1 trillion.

This also causes China’s debt problem to spill over. Trade partners, including Europe, are increasingly dissatisfied with the flood of Chinese electric vehicles and other products, yet Beijing appears unwilling to fundamentally change policy direction.

Many economists believe China is not yet facing an imminent financial crisis, partly because its debt is mainly funded by domestic savings rather than foreign investors who could pull out quickly. However, as growth momentum stalls, the massive debt carried by loss‑making firms becomes ever harder to repay; cutting off new loans to these firms could force state‑owned banks to absorb huge losses.

Camille Boullenois, vice‑chair of Rongding Group, said that changing the current system would require accepting large losses, and the Chinese government does not seem ready. She thinks the more likely scenario is a slow worsening of problems, a gradual decline of the financial system and increasingly low efficiency in generating growth.

Delaying debt resolution also lets Xi Jinping keep pouring resources into new technologies, the military and other strategic priorities. Chinese officials see the current window as an opportunity to cement China’s status as a peer great power with the United States, so they treat investments in AI, space technology and energy as critical.

Local financing platforms carry heavy burdens, and low‑interest loans keep corporate borrowing alive. The Chinese government stresses that debt risks are controllable; central‑government borrowing has been about 30% of GDP in recent years, still lower than the United States’ federal debt level. However, this figure does not include the main source of China’s debt problem—the liabilities at the local level.

In recent years, local governments have added several trillion dollars of debt through local financing platforms to meet growth targets and preserve employment. Many of these platforms have been involved in local real‑estate development and have therefore been hit hard by years of a sluggish housing market.

The International Monetary Fund estimates that if official local‑government borrowing and financing‑platform debt are combined, China’s broad‑based government debt swelled to 127% of GDP last year, up from 98% in 2020.

Corporate debt is also rising even as investment opportunities with good returns are dwindling. McKinsey data show that China’s corporate‑debt‑to‑GDP ratio last year was about twice the global average.

Cheap credit is a key driver. Rongding Group cites People’s Bank of China data indicating that by the end of last year, more than half of new corporate loans were priced at or below the benchmark rate offered to the most creditworthy corporate clients, a share far higher than a few years ago. The median borrowing rate for listed Chinese manufacturers was about 2.4% last year.

Expanding consumption could help break the cycle, but policy shifts involve strategic trade‑offs. To resolve the debt issue, China may need to fundamentally adjust its growth strategy, reducing reliance on factory‑type fixed‑asset investment and export‑driven growth. Many economists argue the government should prioritize policies that encourage households to spend more, preventing further debt accumulation.

World Bank data show that in 2024 household consumption accounted for 40% of China’s GDP, compared with nearly 70% in the United States, highlighting a stark structural difference between the two economies.

China’s GDP grew 4.3% year‑on‑year in the second quarter of this year, the slowest pace in over three years, with a sizable share of that growth coming from exports, underscoring weak domestic demand.

Beijing says it wants to boost household consumption, but that would require the government to relinquish some control over economic resource allocation and could divert funds away from industries that Xi prioritizes to narrow the technology gap with the United States.

Jacob Gunter, head of economics and industry research at the Berlin‑based Mercator Institute for China Studies, said Chinese officials tend to stick to the current path, but the system is gradually hitting its own limits. He noted that local governments subsidize loss‑making firms to keep them operating, yet continued losses mean there is no profit to tax, further eroding the fiscal base of local governments.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯震盪一度重貶逾1角 貶幅收斂險守31.9元關卡
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar, Stocks and Forex Volatile, Briefly Dropped Over 0.1, Decline Narrowed, Barely Held the 31.9 Level
paras: 雙十連假過後，台北股匯今(12)日連袂走跌，受中東局勢緊張、國際油價漲勢再起影響，新台幣兌美元一度重挫逾 1 角，但在央行進場調節後，貶勢逐漸收斂，終場收在 31.895 元、小貶 2 分，驚險守住 31.9 元關卡，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 27.17 億美元。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數小跌 0.03%，韓元強勢升值 0.79%，新加坡幣與人民幣均升值 0.12%；日元則貶值 0.18%，新台幣貶值 0.06%，主要亞幣走勢不同調。
台股今日面臨電子權值壓盤，但台積電跌幅收斂，金融股、貨櫃海運三雄齊力拉抬，加權指數開低走高，留下逾 500 點下影線，49000 點失而復得，終場小跌 11.48 點，收49301.96點。外資今日賣超 521.98 億元。
儘管近期經濟數據顯示美國通膨壓力持續存在，但市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍相對有限。根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預估，聯準會本月升息至少1碼的機率為19.4%，不過，認為12月會議升息的機率高達85.8%。
paras_en: After the Double‑Ten holiday, Taipei’s stock and forex markets fell together on the 12th. Fueled by heightened Middle‑East tensions and a resurgence in global oil prices, the New Taiwan dollar slipped more than 0.1 against the US dollar. After the central bank stepped in to smooth the market, the depreciation eased and closed at 31.895 NT$, a modest 2‑cent loss, narrowly staying above the 31.9 threshold. The total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets amounted to US$2.717 billion.

Looking at major currencies against the dollar today, central‑bank data show the US Dollar Index fell 0.03%. The Korean won appreciated strongly by 0.79%, while the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each rose 0.12%. The Japanese yen weakened 0.18% and the New Taiwan dollar fell 0.06%, indicating divergent moves among Asian currencies.

Taiwan’s equity market faced pressure from heavyweight electronics stocks, but TSMC’s losses narrowed. Financial stocks and the three major container‑shipping firms rallied, pushing the weighted index from an opening decline to a gain, leaving a lower shadow of over 500 points. The 49,000‑point level was briefly lost and then regained, ending down 11.48 points at 49,301.96. Foreign investors sold a net US$52.198 billion today.

Although recent economic data show that inflation pressure in the United States remains, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Federal Reserve meeting are still relatively modest. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of at least a one‑basis‑point increase this month is 19.4%, while the chance of a hike at the December meeting is as high as 85.8%.

items.title: 油價回落與出口商拋售 韓元飆升至兩年新高
items.title_en: Oil price drop and exporters sell-off, Won soars to two-year high
paras: 韓元周一(12日)飆升至兩年來新高，主要受國際油價下跌和南韓國內企業大量拋售美元的支撐。
在結束為期3天的公眾假期後，南韓外匯市場周一恢復交易，韓元兌美元強勁升值。韓元匯率盤中一度下跌 0.8% 至1美元兌 1,333.30 韓元，刷新近兩年來最高，隨後漲幅收窄至約 0.5%。
市場分析師，本次韓元走強主要受雙重因素驅動。首先，國際原油價格下挫削弱了美元強勢，帶動歐元、英鎊與日元等主要貨幣全面回升。其次，南韓本土出口企業(特別是半導體巨頭)大量拋售美元，加上創紀錄的出口成長與經常帳順差擴大，大幅增加了外匯市場上的美元供給。
首爾友利銀行(Woori Bank)經濟學家 Min Gyeong-won 指出，出口商的結匯需求將持續為韓元提供支撐，不過當天因日本市場休市導致整體交易量較為清淡，進一步加劇了匯率波動。
今年以來，韓元兌美元已累計升值達 7.7%。憑藉強勁的出口表現與企業結匯潮，韓元已擺脫上半年作為亞洲表現最差貨幣之一的陰霾，逆轉成為下半年亞洲地區表現最強勁的貨幣之一。
paras_en: The Korean won surged to a two‑year high on Monday the 12th, driven mainly by falling international oil prices and a massive sell‑off of dollars by South Korean companies.

After a three‑day public holiday, South Korea’s foreign‑exchange market resumed trading on Monday and the won appreciated sharply against the dollar. The rate briefly fell 0.8% to 1,333.30 won per dollar, a near‑two‑year peak, before the gain narrowed to about 0.5%.

Market analysts say the won’s strength this time was driven by two factors. First, the drop in global crude oil prices weakened the dollar, prompting a broad rally in major currencies such as the euro, pound and yen. Second, domestic exporters – especially semiconductor giants – dumped large amounts of dollars, and record export growth together with an expanding current‑account surplus greatly increased the supply of dollars in the FX market.

Woori Bank economist Min Gyeong‑won noted that exporters’ demand for foreign‑exchange settlement will continue to support the won, but trading was relatively thin that day because the Japanese market was closed, which further amplified rate volatility.

Since the start of the year, the won has appreciated by 7.7% against the dollar. Backed by strong export performance and a wave of corporate settlement, the won has shed its reputation as one of Asia’s worst‑performing currencies in the first half and has turned into one of the strongest performers in the region for the second half.

paras: 美元周五(9日)上漲，歐元則連續第五周下跌。隨著油價回升、抹去稍早跌幅，歐元早盤漲勢逐漸消退。不過，由於法國陷入困境的公債市場趨於穩定，歐元近期的賣壓有所緩和。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 9th), while the euro fell for a fifth straight week. As oil prices recovered, erasing earlier losses, the euro’s early‑session gains gradually faded. However, with France’s troubled sovereign‑bond market stabilising, selling pressure on the euro has eased somewhat recently.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.13% to 102.25. The index is up about 0.3% this week, marking a fourth consecutive week of gains and the longest winning streak since May 2025.

On Monday, the euro slipped to $1.1161, a 17‑month low. Investors worry that France’s public debt has hit a historic high and that the political path to cutting budget spending is fraught with difficulty. By contrast, the U.S. economy and the dollar appear relatively strong.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1198, down about 0.5% for the week, setting the longest run of weekly declines against the dollar since early 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian sovereign bonds are expected to fall this week. Those premiums surged in late September, but as investors await new developments and decide whether higher compensation is needed for fiscal and political risk, the premiums have been gradually retreating.
Trump hints he will not attack Iran

Earlier on Friday, global bond markets steadied. U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not attack Iran before the November 3 mid‑term elections and claimed that the U.S. and Tehran had productive war‑related talks. The news knocked oil prices lower earlier in the session.

Eugene Epstein, head of transactions and structured products at Moneycorp, said, “There are several factors at play right now, including rising oil prices and France’s issues, so it’s hard to pinpoint which factor is having the bigger market impact.”

“In reality, I think the market is in a wait‑and‑see mode today. Everyone is waiting for Fed officials’ remarks to roll out, because it’s clear the dollar is very sensitive to whatever the Fed speakers say,” he added.

However, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a vessel 13 nautical miles west of the UAE peninsula was struck by an unidentified flying object, after which crude oil prices rebounded from their lows.
U.S. crude rose 0.6% to $92.04 a barrel, after dipping to a intraday low of $90.01. Brent crude gained 0.58% to $104.88, after an earlier low of $102.33.
Bond yields around the world have been climbing for several weeks, driven by expectations of rate hikes by central banks and concerns over sovereign fiscal health.
Central‑bank policy is in focus
Even though recent economic data show persistent inflation pressure, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Fed policy meeting remain relatively modest.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 19.4% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least one basis point this month, while the odds of a hike at the December meeting are as high as 85.8%.

A Michigan University consumer survey released on Friday showed that, as Middle‑East conflict pushes up living costs, U.S. consumer confidence slipped further in early October and households grew more pessimistic about the economic outlook.

While several Fed officials have said further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, some have opposed an immediate increase, arguing the Fed should stay patient and flexible before deciding the future rate path.

French sovereign bonds remain under pressure, and politicians find it hard to meaningfully cut the budget deficit before a divisive 2027 election. Earlier this week, Spain announced an early election, adding further pressure on the euro.
The pound rose 0.08% to $1.3235 against the dollar but has been falling for a seventh consecutive week, the longest streak of declines since November 2024.

items.title: 資金急找避風港！全球貨幣市場基金吸金1538億美元 美股基金轉失血
items.title_en: Funds Scramble for Safe Havens! Global Money‑Market Funds Pull in $153.81 Billion, US Equity Funds Turn Red
paras: 全球債市賣壓加劇，美債殖利率攀高與油價居高不下，加深投資人對通膨的疑慮，促使資金轉向避險。根據LSEG Lipper數據，截至10月7日當周，全球貨幣市場基金淨流入1,538.1億美元，創5月6日當周以來最多；美國股票基金則終止連兩周吸金，遭撤資51.1億美元。
標普500指數本周稍早觸及7,844.52點歷史新高，隨後回落。通膨疑慮引發債市拋售，美國10年期公債殖利率攀抵5.3645%，創2002年4月以來新高，壓抑市場情緒，也促使投資人在股市上漲之際獲利了結。
歐洲債務問題同樣牽動市場。法國預算赤字占國內生產毛額(GDP)比重超過5%，加上明年總統大選恐加劇政治分歧，推升其10年期公債殖利率至4.994%，創24年新高。
全球股票基金當周僅淨流入5.6億美元，為近三周最少。歐洲與亞洲股票基金分別吸金61.9億及61.6億美元，美國則出現9月16日當周以來首次淨流出。其中，美國大型、中型及小型股基金分別失血140.8億、10.3億及8.34億美元。
不過，資金並未全面撤離美股。美國產業型基金仍吸金56.8億美元，以科技類股的45.3億美元居首，公用事業與工業類股也分別吸金11.8億及10.4億美元。
債券基金也持續獲資金青睞。全球債券基金淨流入260.3億美元，創7月8日當周以來最多；其中，美國債券基金吸金197.8億美元，創單周紀錄。美國短中期政府債券與公債基金吸金67.6億美元，為六個月最多，短中期投資等級債券基金另吸金50.4億美元。
美國貨幣市場基金則淨流入684.9億美元，扭轉前一周淨流出436億美元的情況。此外，全球黃金及其他貴金屬基金連續第四周吸金，當周流入14.1億美元。新興市場債券基金吸金14.8億美元，股票基金則連續第五周失血，淨流出7.52億美元。
paras_en: Global bond‑market selling pressure intensified, with U.S. Treasury yields climbing and oil prices staying high, deepening investors' inflation concerns and prompting a shift toward safe‑haven assets. According to LSEG Lipper data, in the week to October 7 the net inflow into global money‑market funds was $153.81 billion, the largest since the week of May 6; U.S. equity funds, meanwhile, ended a two‑week inflow streak with a net outflow of $5.11 billion.

The S&P 500 touched a record high of 7,844.52 points earlier this week before pulling back. Inflation worries sparked a bond‑market sell‑off, pushing the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield to 5.3645%—a peak not seen since April 2002—dampening market sentiment and prompting investors to take profits as equities rose.

Europe's debt issues also weighed on markets. France’s budget deficit exceeds 5% of GDP, and the upcoming presidential election next year could heighten political divisions, lifting its 10‑year sovereign yield to 4.994%, a 24‑year high.

Global equity funds recorded a net inflow of only $560 million for the week, the lowest in nearly three weeks. European and Asian equity funds attracted $6.19 billion and $6.16 billion respectively, while the U.S. saw its first weekly net outflow since the week of September 16. U.S. large‑cap, mid‑cap and small‑cap equity funds lost $14.08 billion, $1.03 billion and $834 million respectively.

Nevertheless, money has not fled U.S. equities entirely. U.S. sector funds still drew $5.68 billion, led by technology funds with $4.53 billion, while utilities and industrials attracted $1.18 billion and $1.04 billion respectively.

Bond funds continued to enjoy inflows. Global bond funds saw a net inflow of $26.03 billion, the highest since the week of July 8; U.S. bond funds alone attracted $19.78 billion, a single‑week record. U.S. short‑ and intermediate‑term government and sovereign bond funds pulled in $6.76 billion, the most in six months, and short‑ and intermediate‑term investment‑grade bond funds added another $5.04 billion.

U.S. money‑market funds recorded a net inflow of $68.49 billion, reversing the previous week’s outflow of $43.6 billion. Meanwhile, global gold and other precious‑metal funds logged a fourth consecutive week of inflows, bringing in $1.41 billion. Emerging‑market bond funds attracted $1.48 billion, while equity funds suffered a fifth straight week of outflows, netting a $752 million withdrawal.

items.title: 史上最大重組月底上路！683家日企逐步從東證指數剔除  逾1兆美元被動資金面臨調整
items.title_en: Largest Reorganization in History Set for End of Month! 683 Japanese Companies Gradually Removed from TOPIX, Over $1 Trillion in Passive Funds Face Adjustments
paras: 日本交易所集團(JPX)周三(7日)公布東證股價指數(Topix)史上最大規模成分股重組，10月30日起生效。按新流動性與自由流通市值標準，683檔現有股票不符納入條件、35檔來自標準市場與成長市場的新股納入。若執行順利，Topix成分股將由8月底約1636檔、兩年內降至約986檔，較現有股數接近腰斬。
這是Topix改革第二階段。第一階段2025年1月已把成分股由約2200檔壓至約1700檔，此次進一步把「上市市場」篩選邏輯改為「交易活躍度＋自由流通市值」，現有公司須滿足年度換手率等流動性要求，並進入自由流通市值前97%。新納入者須進前96%。
未達上述標準者不會即日出局，指數權重按季遞減，至2028年7月降至零，若明年10月重評重新達標可中止減權，2028年10月起改為年度再平衡。
與此同時，被動資金規模使改革備受全球關注。大和證券首席量化橋本淳一上月預估，約166兆日元(1.1兆美元)追蹤Topix。另據瑞銀預估，約155兆日元(1兆美元)，JPX統計則約160兆日元。
被列入剔除名單者面臨指數基金分期減持，新納入如日本麥當勞、東映動畫、叫車平台GO等可獲被動買盤與主動基金關注，但瑞銀日股分析師小林千紗指出，被剔除公司佔家數約三分之一，但佔Topix總市值不到3%，對指數表現與整體流動性的直接衝擊有限，主要影響是个股層面而非大盤方向。
JPX改革目的在提升可投資性與逼出公司治理。近年，JPX社長山道裕己持續推資本效率、股東回報與披露標準；Amundi Japan股票投資主管石原博美認為，成分股縮減「基本正面」，企業須持續證明留指數合理性，若分紅、回購、ROE改善逐案累積，可抬升日股整體評價。部分小型股已提前增加股東回報來降低剔出風險，但主動基金仍要分辨「為保指數而派息」與「真改善治理」的差別。
結構上，JPX新規更重視自由流通市值，有利三菱日聯、豐田、軟銀等大型藍籌股。
高盛分析師Bruce Kirk認為，AI相關大型股指數影響力會再升，東海東京分析師三道翔太則稱小型股剔出風險持續、大盤趨勢可能加強。
短期看，被剔小股有被動賣壓與流動性折價，新納入股有建倉支撐；中長期看，Topix從「廣泛涵蓋全市場」轉向「流動性優先的核心池」，可投資度提升，但也會犧牲小型股、低成交公司的價格發現功能。對追蹤Topix的ETF與退休基金而言，未來兩年再平衡節奏比單日調整更關鍵。
paras_en: Japan Exchange Group (JPX) announced on Wednesday (the 7th) the biggest ever component reshuffle of the TOPIX index, effective October 30. Under the new liquidity and free‑float market‑cap criteria, 683 existing stocks fail the inclusion rules while 35 new stocks from the Standard and Growth markets will be added. If implemented smoothly, TOPIX constituents will drop from about 1,636 at the end of August to roughly 986 within two years, nearly halving the current count.

This is the second phase of the TOPIX reform. The first phase, completed in January 2025, reduced the number of constituents from roughly 2,200 to about 1,700. The current phase changes the "listing market" screening logic to "trading activity + free‑float market cap"; existing companies must meet annual turnover‑rate liquidity requirements and rank within the top 97% of free‑float market cap, while newcomers must rank within the top 96%.

Companies that do not meet the new standards will not be removed immediately; their index weight will be phased down quarterly, reaching zero by July 2028. If they regain compliance in the October review next year, the weight reduction can be halted, and from October 2028 the index will be rebalanced annually.

At the same time, the massive scale of passive capital has drawn global attention to the reform. Daiwa Securities’ chief quant Junichi Hashimoto estimated last month that about ¥166 trillion (US$1.1 trillion) tracks TOPIX. UBS estimates around ¥155 trillion (US$1 trillion), while JPX’s own data put the figure at roughly ¥160 trillion.

Those placed on the removal list will face staged sell‑downs by index funds. New entrants such as McDonald’s Japan, Toei Animation and ride‑hailing platform GO can attract passive buying and active‑fund interest, but UBS Japan‑equity analyst Chisa Kobayashi notes that the companies slated for removal represent about one‑third of the number of constituents yet account for less than 3% of TOPIX’s total market value, so the direct impact on index performance and overall liquidity is limited, affecting mainly individual stocks rather than the market direction.

JPX’s reform aims to improve investability and push better corporate governance. In recent years, JPX President Hiroki Yamaguchi has promoted capital efficiency, shareholder returns and disclosure standards; Amundi Japan equity head Hiromi Ishihara sees the reduction of constituents as "basically positive," arguing that companies will need to continuously prove their relevance to the index, and that incremental improvements in dividends, buybacks and ROE can lift the overall valuation of Japanese equities. Some small‑cap stocks have already increased shareholder returns to lower their exclusion risk, but active managers must still differentiate between "dividends paid just to stay in the index" and genuine governance improvements.
Structurally, the new JPX rules place greater emphasis on free‑float market cap, benefiting large blue‑chip stocks such as Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Toyota and SoftBank.

Goldman Sachs analyst Bruce Kirk believes AI‑related large‑cap stocks will gain even more influence in the index, while Tokai Tokyo analyst Shota Sando says the risk of small‑cap removals persists and could reinforce broader market trends.

In the short term, the removed small caps may face passive selling pressure and liquidity discounts, while the newly added stocks could receive buying support. Over the medium to long term, TOPIX will shift from a "broad market‑covering" index to a "liquidity‑first core pool," enhancing investability but sacrificing price‑discovery for small‑cap and low‑turnover stocks. For TOPIX‑tracking ETFs and pension funds, the rebalancing cadence over the next two years will be more critical than any single‑day adjustment.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 歐洲公債殖利率自高點回落
items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Weakens, European Government Bond Yields Retreat from Peaks
paras: 美元周四(8日)走弱，歐元區公債殖利率的升勢暫歇，而市場對聯準會(Fed)今年利率走向的預期大致維持不變。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報102.17，此前一度升至102.46。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.1204美元，盤中一度跌至1.1171美元。
歐元區政府公債殖利率再度大幅上升，油價飆漲加劇通膨疑慮，投資人持續拋售法國、義大利等高負債國家的公債。
不過，隨著殖利率升勢逐漸降溫，歐元也從盤中低點回升。法國10年期公債殖利率上升2.7個基點至4.8873%，盤中一度攀升至4.9685%。
在投資人密切檢視法國的債務規模、預算赤字，以及2027年總統大選前的政治前景之際，法國受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
西班牙方面，工會周三宣布將於11月11日發動全國性總罷工，抗議住宅問題，而這場示威距離提前舉行的大選僅剩數周。
Fed釋放升息謹慎訊號
市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍偏低。聯準會周三公布最新一次會議紀要後，顯示決策官員認為通膨是經濟展望面臨的最大風險，分析師則表示，會議紀要並未帶來意外訊號。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，為了讓通膨降至聯準會2%的目標，未來可能仍需要進一步升息，但他也表示升息步調具「彈性」，並為即將舉行的10月會議暫停升息留下空間。
華勒的言論呼應了部分聯準會官員上周的說法，他們均釋放出希望在進一步升息上保持耐心的訊號。
SimCorp多資產投資決策研究主管Christoph Schon表示，「多數其他貨幣似乎都與其貨幣政策預期呈反向關係，但那是因為過去一切都受到美元和聯準會主導，而這種情況在過去幾周仍持續存在。」
「有趣的是，現在還有另一個影響歐元的因素，也就是法國、如今甚至西班牙的政治危機……因此，這是一段短暫的時期，焦點不在利率差或貨幣政策，而是一場非常特殊的歐元危機，而在這個案例中，它正影響歐元。」
市場押注12月升息
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會本月升息至少25個基點的機率僅17.2%，略低於一周前的24.4%。不過，投資人押注12月會議升息的機率則達到81.2%。
在華勒發表上述評論後，高盛分析師在報告中表示，他們仍預期聯準會12月將再升息25個基點，並下調12月不升息的機率，因為華勒的言論代表政策立場轉向更加鷹派。
在更為鷹派的談話中，聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩林(Alberto Musalem)表示，美國央行需要再次升息，才能讓通膨回到2%的目標。
經濟數據方面，美國勞工部表示，上周初領失業金人數減少2,000人至19.7萬人，略低於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的20萬人。最新數據持續顯示美國就業市場保持穩定。
歐元區通膨可能高於目前已經偏高的預測，但歐洲央行(ECB)決策官員壓低了市場對短期升息的押注，多名官員周四表示，從基本面趨勢來看，情況其實較為溫和。
德國公債與法國、義大利等歐元區高負債國家公債之間不斷擴大的殖利率差距，已推動歐元跌至2024年5月以來最低水準。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.07%至1.3219美元，此前英國央行(BoE)總裁Andrew Bailey表示，全球債券市場受到高額借貸與不斷升高的通膨壓力衝擊之際，各國政府需要加倍努力，展現修復公共財政的能力。
美元兌日元下跌0.12%至157.88日元。日本銀行(BoJ)表示，原物料成本上升所帶動的價格漲勢正蔓延至消費品，部分企業提高價格的頻率也有所增加，顯示日銀對通膨壓力擴大的情況感到擔憂。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Thursday (the 8th), pausing the rise in Eurozone government bond yields, while market expectations for the Fed's rate path this year remained largely unchanged.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.08% to 102.17 after briefly climbing to 102.46.
The euro rose 0.08% against the dollar to $1.1204, after dipping intraday to $1.1171.
Eurozone sovereign yields surged again as oil price spikes heightened inflation concerns, prompting investors to continue selling bonds of heavily indebted countries such as France and Italy.
However, as the yield rally cooled, the euro recovered from its intraday low. France's 10‑year yield rose 2.7 basis points to 4.8873%, briefly reaching 4.9685% during the session.
The impact on France was especially pronounced as investors closely examined its debt size, budget deficit, and political outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
In Spain, unions announced on Wednesday a nationwide general strike on November 11 to protest housing issues, a protest taking place only weeks before an early election.
Fed signals cautious rate‑hike stance

Market expectations for a rate hike at the Fed's later policy meeting this month remain low. After the Fed released minutes of its latest meeting on Wednesday, officials said inflation remains the biggest risk to the economic outlook, and analysts said the minutes offered no surprise signals.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that further rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target, but he also noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible,” leaving room to pause at the upcoming October meeting.
Waller's comments echoed remarks from other Fed officials last week, who all signaled a desire to be patient on any further tightening.

Christoph Schon, head of multi‑asset investment decision research at SimCorp, said, “Most other currencies seem to move opposite to their monetary‑policy expectations, but that’s because everything has been dominated by the dollar and the Fed, and that situation has persisted over the past few weeks.”

“Interestingly, there is now another factor affecting the euro – the political crises in France and now even Spain… So this is a short‑term episode where the focus is not on rate differentials or policy, but on a very specific euro crisis that is currently influencing the currency,” he added.
Markets bet on a December hike

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 17.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points this month, down slightly from 24.4% a week ago. However, investors see an 81.2% chance of a hike at the December meeting.

After Waller’s remarks, a Goldman Sachs analyst wrote that they still expect a 25‑basis‑point hike in December and lowered the probability of no hike, interpreting Waller’s comments as a shift toward a more hawkish stance.
In an even more hawkish tone, Alberto Musalem, president of St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank, said the U.S. central bank needs another rate increase to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

On the data front, the U.S. Labor Department reported that initial unemployment claims fell by 2,000 to 197,000 last week, slightly below the Reuters poll forecast of 200,000, indicating the labor market remains stable.

Eurozone inflation may be higher than already elevated forecasts, but ECB policymakers have dampened market bets on a near‑term hike, with several officials on Thursday noting that, based on fundamentals, the situation is actually fairly moderate.
The widening yield gap between German bonds and those of high‑debt Eurozone members such as France and Italy has pushed the euro down to its lowest level since May 2024.

The pound rose 0.07% to $1.3219 after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that as global bond markets face high borrowing and rising inflation pressures, governments need to work harder to demonstrate fiscal repair capability.

The dollar fell 0.12% to ¥157.88. The Bank of Japan said rising raw‑material costs are feeding price increases into consumer goods, with some firms raising prices more frequently, showing the BOJ’s concern over expanding inflation pressures.
